Title: Revenue Operations Manager
Description:
Grow with us

Upsales was founded in 2003, grew without a single outside investor, and has been profitable ever since. No VC pressure. No compromises. Just a product customers keep paying for.

We build the leading CRM and AI platform for B2B sales, and we're now in our highest growth phase in years, one of the very few SaaS companies growing profitably while staying genuinely ahead on AI.

If you want real autonomy, colleagues who push you, and work that moves the needle from day one, you'll fit right in.

AI-first mindset

We're not looking for someone who simply uses AI. We want someone who weaponizes it. You treat tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI copilots as force multipliers, allowing you to deliver at a level and speed others can't match. For you, AI isn't an add-on, it's the default operating system for how you think, work, and lead. You're relentlessly curious about new capabilities, and you push the limits of what's possible, turning AI into a competitive advantage for yourself, Upsales, and our customers. This is a role for someone with real ambition: someone who wants to set a new standard for efficiency, precision, and impact in the age of AI.

The Role

Are you obsessed with structure, love getting things done, and thrive when chaos turns into clarity? Then we have the perfect role for you.

We’re looking for a smart, proactive and tech-savvy Revenue Operations Manager to help us bring more order, insight, and scalability to how we work across sales, customer success and finance. If your dream job includes cleaning up data, automating workflows, and making sure the commercial side of a business runs like clockwork, read on.

What you’ll do

In this role, you’ll be the operational backbone of our commercial teams. You’ll make sure we have clean data, sharp forecasts, and smooth systems. You’ll also bring order to pricing, proposals, contracts, and help us make smarter decisions with better data.

Your Day-to-day Will Include


Track and analyze key metrics like NRR and ARR to support data-driven decisions.
Own the administration around customer agreements, pricing logic, and risk minimization.
Create quotes, presentations, and other sales materials that help close deals.
Build dashboards and reports that give teams the insights they need.
Support the Sales team with relevant tasks to maximize revenue and ensure alignment with company strategy.
Continuously improve and streamline processes to ensure efficiency, scalability, and long-term impact.


Who you are

You’re structured, business-minded, and quick on your feet. You know how to turn complexity into clarity and don’t settle for “good enough” when it comes to tools or processes. You’ve worked in fast-moving environments and thrive when you get both responsibility and speed.

You Bring


3+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or a similar commercial/finance role, preferably in a B2B SaaS environment
Experience with CRM administration and workflow automation (Upsales, Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar)
Comfortable working with SQL
Strong skills in Looker (or equivalent tools). Building reports, tracking churn, and surfacing insights that matter
Curiosity for new tools, AI, and clever hacks to boost sales efficiency
Excellent communication skills in Swedish and English
A sharp mind and a love for structure. You're the kind of person who gets things done and makes everyone else's job easier

Title: Junior Data Scientist
Description:
Kreditz is transforming how businesses assess credit and risk using real-time data and NextGen Credit Scoring solutions.

As one of Europe’s fastest-growing FinTech scaleups - we’ve earned a place on the Sifted 100: Nordics & Benelux list in both 2024 and 2025 and most recently, we were proud to receive a double win at the Credit Management & Compliance Awards 2025, being named both "Fintech Rocket of the Year" and "Breakthrough of the Year".

With strong growth across the Nordics and Europe, our clients range from leading banks and iGaming giants to fast-moving digital innovators.

Now, we’re looking for a Junior Data Scientist who can help transform a high-performing fintech into a billion-dollar business.

About The Position

Kreditz AI/Product team is looking for a Junior Data Scientist to help turn Open Banking transaction data into high-precision credit risk, affordability, and fraud insights. As a regulated AISP and licensed credit reference provider across European markets, Kreditz builds the scoring models, income verifications, and risk detection rules that power modern automated lending. You will work directly on the data analysis, feature engineering, and predictive models behind our core products, alongside our ML Engineers and Senior Data Scientists.

What Can Kreditz Offer


A once-in-a-lifetime growth journey, from startup to Global scaleup
A journey where everyone in the team plays a crucial role for our company’s success
Fun-loving, driven, and passionate colleagues who support each other’s success
A culture that celebrates progress, humility, and teamwork
We win together
24/7 access to gym, sauna and sports facilities at our office, plus additional wellness allowance
Competitive base salary


RESPONSIBILITES

Some Of The Main Responsibilities You Will Cover


Perform exploratory and granular data analysis on large-scale Open Banking (PSD2) transaction datasets, uncovering trends in income stability, recurring obligations, discretionary spending, and default behavior across European markets.
Design, test, and document domain-specific features for our transaction categorization engine, credit risk scoring models (e.g., Kreditz Score), and real-time fraud detection systems.
Support model lifecycle and validation: train, validate, and benchmark supervised learning models (logistic regression, XGBoost/LightGBM, decision trees) using cross-validation, hyperparameter tuning, and standard evaluation metrics (AUC-ROC, Gini, KS-statistic, F1-score).
Investigate model behavior and anomalies through root-cause analysis on edge cases, data drift, and performance discrepancies across banking connections, transaction taxonomies, and cross-border implementations.
Collaborate with Machine Learning Engineers to ensure seamless handoff of verified modeling pipelines and features into production.
Translate technical findings into actionable dashboards, model documentation, and clear presentations for product managers, internal risk committees, and external client stakeholders.


WE ARE LOOKING FOR


Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Quantitative Economics, or a related quantitative field.
0-2 years of experience with strong proficiency in Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, SciPy) and advanced SQL for querying large relational and semi-structured datasets.
Solid grounding in statistical inference, probability distributions, hypothesis testing, and supervised learning algorithms, with a strong desire to understand why a model behaves as it does.
Experience using visualization libraries (matplotlib, seaborn, Plotly) or BI platforms to communicate findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Proven ability to break down ambiguous, open-ended business questions into structured, hypothesis-driven analyses.
Rigorous approach to data sanity checks, unit testing your analysis, and validating your own results before sharing outputs.


WHY JOIN NOW?

Kreditz is scaling from startup to global fintech leader, and this role sits at the center of that growth: the models you help build directly power automated lending decisions across European markets. You'll join at a stage where your work has outsized visibility and impact, working alongside experienced ML Engineers and Senior Data Scientists while helping shape how the team builds and validates models going forward.

APPOINTMENT OF ROLE

Q3/Q4 2026

SCOPE

Full-time, permanent employment (tillsvidareanställning)

SALARY

Competitive salary

REPORTING

You will be reporting to the company’s CPO

WORKPLACE

Danderyd, Stockholm

RECRUITMENT PROCESS

Ongoing selection, we review candidates continuously.

Last day for applications 2nd October 2026

CRIMINAL RECORDS EXTRACT

As part of our recruitment process we will ask you to present a clean criminal records extract

CONTACT

Lorenzo Puccio, VP Strategic Operations, Lorenzo@kreditz.com

For more information about the role feel free to reach out to our CPO Spilios Tzouras, spilios.tzouras@kreditz.com

Intelligent credit- & risk decisions made easy with open banking & AI-technology

Title: Microstrategy & Businessobjects Specialist
Description:
About Cognizant

Cognizant is one of the world's leading professional services companies, helping organizations modernize technology, reimagine processes, and transform experiences so they stay ahead in a fast-changing world. With over 300,000 associates globally, Cognizant combines a passion for client satisfaction, technology innovation, deep industry and business process expertise, and a global, collaborative workforce that embodies the future of work. We are consistently listed among the most admired companies in the world and among the best companies to work for. Our culture is built on a foundation of transparency, inclusion, and collaboration — empowering our people to grow and thrive both professionally and personally. At Cognizant, you won't just be part of a company; you'll be part of a community that is shaping the future of industries across the globe.

Role Summary

We are looking for a senior BI lead who can own the end-to-end design, development and administration of MicroStrategy and SAP BusinessObjects platforms. The candidate will lead a team of BI developers, drive solution architecture, and work closely with business stakeholders to deliver scalable reporting and analytics solutions.

Key Responsibilities


Lead the design, development and delivery of reports, dashboards and documents using MicroStrategy and SAP BusinessObjects (Web Intelligence, Universe Designer / IDT).
Own solution architecture, data modelling and schema design across the BI landscape.
Perform MSTR / BO administration - object management, security model, project configuration, intelligence server tuning and upgrades / migrations.
Optimise report performance, query design and VLDB settings for large data volumes. Translate business requirements into technical specifications and guide the development team through delivery.
Manage code reviews, best practices, deployment and production support.
Coordinate with data engineering and source-system teams on data quality and integration.
Mentor junior developers and provide technical leadership across the engagement.


Mandatory Skills


Strong hands-on expertise in MicroStrategy (Developer / Architect, Web, Schema & Application objects, Intelligence Server, dossiers / dashboards).
Strong experience in SAP BusinessObjects (Web Intelligence, Universe design via IDT / UDT, CMC administration). Solid SQL and data warehousing / dimensional modelling concepts (star / snowflake schema).
Experience with platform administration, upgrades and migrations.
Performance tuning and troubleshooting of reports and BI servers.
Strong stakeholder management and team leadership experience.


Good to Have

Exposure to cloud data platforms (Snowflake, Azure, AWS) and modern BI tools (Power BI / Tableau).

Experience in the Banking / Financial Services domain.

Knowledge of ETL tools and scheduling.

Title: Revenue Operations Specialist (Salesforce & GTM Systems)
Description:
What We Do At Detectify

We’re Detectify, and we’re not your average cybersecurity company. We’re a team obsessed with building cutting-edge tech that actually makes a difference in making the internet a safer place. We’re talking about real-life hackers who know their stuff—you’ll learn from the best and join a team that combines human ingenuity with automation to streamline asset discovery and vulnerability assessments.

Do you want to build the revenue engine behind Detectify's next stage of growth?

We believe that the best revenue teams don't just sell better; they operate smarter.

At Detectify, we're building a modern, AI-enabled revenue engine powered by connected systems, trusted data and actionable insights. We're looking for a Revenue Operations Specialist to help us build the processes, automation and intelligence that power our next stage of growth.

This isn't a traditional Salesforce Administrator role. You'll be at the heart of our commercial organization, partnering with Marketing, Sales, Customer Success and Finance to optimize how we generate, manage and grow revenue.

You'll own key parts of our commercial ecosystem, automate manual processes, improve data quality and transform commercial data into strategic recommendations.

Your insights won't just explain what happened, they'll influence the commercial decisions that shape Detectify's future growth.

What You'll Get To Do

As our Revenue Operations Specialist, you'll build and continuously improve the systems, processes and insights that power our commercial organization. This role reports to the Chief Marketing Officer (CMO) and has a dotted-line relationship with the Chief Sales Officer (CSO). You'll work across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success and Finance, serving as the operational backbone of our Go-to-Market organization. You will:

Own our GTM systems


Administer and optimize Salesforce (configuration, automation, reporting, permissions) and Pardot, manage integrations and improve lead lifecycle, routing and opportunity processes across our GTM stack.


Inform commercial strategy


Go beyond reporting — deliver prescriptive insights through dashboards in Omni and Salesforce that drive decisions on funnel performance, pipeline health, forecasting and campaign effectiveness.


Drive automation and AI


Identify and implement automation opportunities across Marketing, Sales and CS. Use AI and Salesforce Flows to improve CRM hygiene, workflows and efficiency, and continuously evaluate new tools.


Own our commercial data


Maintain CRM data quality, governance and enrichment to give GTM teams one trusted source of truth for forecasting and executive reporting.


Who you are

We're looking for someone who's equally comfortable working in Salesforce, solving business problems and collaborating with stakeholders across the business.

You'll Likely Have


3–5 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations or Marketing Operations.
Hands-on Salesforce Administrator experience, including configuration, Flows, automation, reporting and user management.
Experience with Salesforce Pardot (Marketing Cloud Account Engagement).
Experience building dashboards and translating data into actionable business insights.
Strong understanding of lead management, campaign attribution and revenue processes.
A passion for using automation and AI to improve productivity and solve business problems.
Strong analytical thinking and the ability to turn data into recommendations.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success and Finance.


What success looks like

In Your First Year, You'll Help Us


Increase confidence in our commercial data and reporting.
Improve lead routing, campaign attribution and funnel visibility.
Deliver insights that directly influence strategic business decisions.
Reduce manual work through automation and AI.
Strengthen forecasting and executive reporting.
Build a scalable Revenue Operations function that enables Detectify's continued growth.


What's in it for you?

Revenue Operations is a strategic function at Detectify.

You'll work directly with our CMO, partner closely with our CSO and collaborate with leaders across the business to shape how we scale our commercial organization. You'll have the opportunity to influence strategy, modernize our GTM systems, and experiment with AI and automation to create real business impact.

Hybrid work

This position is for the Stockholm office. We offer hybrid working, with access to our office in central Stockholm and would like to see you at the office at least 3 days per week

So, what do you think? We are proud to foster an inclusive workplace free from discrimination. We strongly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and background will lead to a better environment for our employees and a better product. This is something we value deeply and we encourage everyone to be a part of changing the way the world thinks about security!

If you're excited about building smarter systems, uncovering meaningful insights and helping a high-growth SaaS company scale, we'd love to hear from you.

Join the Team Behind the Revenue Engine

At boost.ai, we’re redefining how people interact with companies. As a Gartner Magic Quadrant Conversational AI Leader, we empower organizations around the world to deliver next-generation customer experiences through intelligent chat and voice automation. Because AI is our core product, we believe in practicing what we preach, using cutting-edge AI tools internally to optimize our way of working. You’ll be the operational architect ensuring the data, systems, and AI-driven workflows behind every deal work flawlessly.

1–3 years of experience in Revenue Ops, Sales Ops, Business Operations or a similar role.
Strong Salesforce Proficiency: Hands-on experience working inside Salesforce is required. You must understand its structure and how fields, objects, and reports interact under the hood.
AI Tool Fluency: Practical, hands-on experience using Generative AI tools to solve work problems, format data, write formulas, or accelerate daily tasks.
Comfort with structured data: A natural attention to detail. you instantly spot data irregularities or things that "don't look right."
Process oriented: The ability to strictly follow defined processes while proactively finding ways to improve them over time.
Strong communication: Clear communication skills and confidence collaborating across international teams spanning EMEA and North America.


Bonus points if you:


Have deep experience with Salesforce automation tools (Flows, validation rules, or integrations).
Understand basic SaaS concepts like subscriptions, ARR, billing cycles, or renewals.
Enjoy documenting how things work so others don’t have to guess.
Have partnered with Finance, Marketing, Revenue Management or Customer Success teams before


You’ll love this role if you:


Get a strange sense of satisfaction from clean data and well-designed processes.
Dislike doing the same manual task twice and would rather spend time automating or AI-prompting a solution than doing manual data entry.
Are genuinely excited about the future of AI-driven business productivity.
Learn fast, ask great questions, and love "connecting the dots" across global teams.Enjoy figuring out how systems work (and why they sometimes don’t)
Prefer fixing root causes instead of applying manual band-aids
Like being the person who connects the dots across teams
Care deeply about things “flowing” correctly from one step to the next
Are curious about an AI-driven businesses
Learn fast, ask good questions, and aren’t afraid to dig into details
Are energized by working in a global, cross-regional environment spanning EMEA and North America
Get a little nerdy about Salesforce, workflows, and reporting


Key Responsibilities


Sales Execution & Revenue Systems Support:
Salesforce Record Reviews: Support sales throughout the deal lifecycle by conducting pre-close Salesforce record reviews to ensure accurate billing and reporting readiness.
Workflow Automation: Assist with active Salesforce administration, supporting flow automation, integrations, testing, and quality checks to ensure reliable data flow.
Data Hygiene & Accuracy: Ensure exceptional CRM data accuracy and hygiene by validating records, flagging discrepancies, and streamlining data entry.
System Troubleshooting: Partner with Revenue Management and RevOps leadership to troubleshoot system problems, resolve data issues, and escalate complex technical errors.
AI-Driven Efficiency & Process Optimization
Identify opportunities to embed AI tools (e.g., Gemini, Claude, Slackbot, or internal AI frameworks) into daily RevOps workflows to speed up data handling and reporting.
Prompt Engineering & Scripting: Create and refine prompts, internal AI assistants, or low-code automations to analyze sales data, draft documentation, and summarize pipeline health.
Root-Cause Resolution: Eliminate repetitive manual tasks by building automated Salesforce shortcuts or AI-assisted workflows.
Data, Enablement & Cross-Functional Insights
Dashboard Modernization & Reporting: Build, maintain, and modernize Salesforce reports and dashboards to provide leadership and cross-functional teams with clear visibility into pipeline health, sales performance, and key revenue metrics.
AI-Enhanced Documentation: Create and maintain clear sales process documentation, playbooks, and system guidance, leveraging AI tools to keep training materials dynamically updated as workflows evolve.
Sales Onboarding & Collaboration: Partner closely with Sales Enablement and cross-functional stakeholders (Finance, Marketing, Customer Success) to support sales training initiatives, ensuring new hires seamlessly adopt our revenue systems and automated workflows.

What Is There For You


The opportunity to play a crucial role that greatly influences the bottom line globally for one of the most exciting tech companies in the Nordics.
The chance to join a fast-growing team on an exciting trajectory.
Talented and extremely motivated colleagues in all departments
An engaging work environment with people who share a common

Boost.ai is the trusted leader in AI-powered customer experience solutions for regulated industries. Built for security, speed, and scale, the platform enables fast deployment, high-resolution rates, and full hybrid control through seamless orchestration of traditional NLU and LLMs. With over 600 live virtual agents, and more than 150 million automated conversations, boost.ai helps enterprises around the world resolve with confidence, automate at scale, and trust every conversation.

Title: Field Effectiveness Lead
Description:
Support the Growth of Some of Sweden’s Most Loved Coffee Brands




JDE is one of the world’s leading coffee and tea companies, home to iconic brands including Gevalia, L'OR, Jacobs, Tassimo, Senseo and Espresso House Coffee. As JDE continues to strengthen its Swedish retail organisation, we are looking for a commercially driven and analytically minded Field Effectiveness Lead to join the team in Stockholm.




This is a key role at the heart of the sales organisation, responsible for improving how field sales teams operate, execute and deliver results. You will act as the link between field sales and internal stakeholders, helping translate commercial priorities into clear actions, tools and processes that maximise execution in-store and drive business performance.




The Opportunity




As Field Effectiveness Lead, you will act as the link between field sales and internal stakeholders, helping create alignment across commercial priorities, activity planning and execution. You will support the field sales organisation with reporting, analysis, planning and sales systems, ensuring teams have the right information and tools to succeed.




The role combines sales operations, commercial planning and business support, making it ideal for someone who enjoys improving processes, creating structure and turning data into actionable insights. You will work closely with Regional Managers, Key Account Managers, Shopper & Category teams and Marketing to strengthen execution and maximise the impact of commercial initiatives in the Swedish market.




Key Responsibilities




Coordinate field sales planning and priority setting in line with commercial objectives and activity plans.
Support target setting and KPI follow-up for the field organisation, ensuring clear performance tracking across key commercial metrics.
Develop and maintain reporting, tools and data that help drive effective decision-making and stronger business results.
Act as a key point of contact between Field Sales and teams across Sales, Shopper Marketing, Category, Marketing, Customer Service and Demand Planning.
Support the development of sales systems and processes, helping create efficient and consistent ways of working across the field organisation.
Champion Perfect Store execution and support initiatives that strengthen in-store performance and compliance.
Identify opportunities to improve field sales effectiveness through better planning, insights and execution.
Support field sales capability development through training initiatives, sales meetings and best-practice sharing.




Build the Future from Stockholm




As part of JDE's continued development in Sweden, you will work closely with colleagues across Sales, Marketing and Category functions while helping strengthen commercial execution in one of JDE's most important markets.




This role offers a unique opportunity to gain broad exposure across the business and work with some of Sweden's most recognised coffee brands while contributing to the ongoing development of sales excellence and field effectiveness.




Who Are You?




You are organised, analytical and commercially minded, with a genuine interest in how strong execution drives business performance. You enjoy working across functions, building relationships and creating structure that helps teams perform at their best.




You are likely to bring:




Minimum 3 years’ experience from FMCG sales, field sales, sales operations, category management or a similar commercial environment.
Solid understanding of retail execution and in-store activation.
Experience working with CRM, reporting and sales planning tools.
Strong analytical skills and confidence working with Excel and PowerPoint.
The ability to turn data and insights into practical recommendations and actions.
Strong stakeholder management skills and experience collaborating across multiple functions.
Fluent in Swedish and English




Personally, you are proactive, structured and detail oriented. You communicate clearly, enjoy solving problems and thrive in environments where collaboration and continuous improvement are key to success.




For this role, JDE is working together with Nigel Wright. Any questions please contact Marie Drugge. Please note that no applicants will be contacted until earliest August 12th.

Title: Data Scientists & ML Engineers
Description:
Vårt team skapar datadrivna effektiva verksamheter - Visst vill du vara med?

Vill du arbeta med AI, Machine Learning och datadriven utveckling i projekt som gör skillnad på riktigt? På Agio får du kombinera teknik, analys och innovation i uppdrag som spänner över viktiga samhällsfunktioner.

Vi söker nu erfarna Data Scientists och ML Engineers till våra team i Stockholm och Luleå. Du väljer själv vilken ort du vill utgå ifrån.

Om rollerna

Som Data Scientist eller ML Engineer på Agio hjälper du våra kunder att ta nästa steg i sin digitala resa.

Våra kunder behöver stöd inom dessa två huvudinriktningar, och du behöver inte vara stark inom båda. En riktigt bra Data Scientist kan vara relevant för oss även utan erfarenhet som ML Engineer, och vice versa.

Data Scientist

Du använder data för att skapa konkret affärs- och verksamhetsvärde genom avancerad analys, statistik, Machine Learning och AI – för att exempelvis förutse, klassificera, optimera och skapa bättre beslutsstöd. Vi söker teknikorienterade Data Scientists som har en stark programmeringsvana. Du arbetar med:
Machine Learning-modeller för prediktion, klassificering och optimering
Prediktioner och prognoser
Att testa hypoteser och genomföra A/B-tester
Att träna, testa och utvärdera modeller
Att förklara analyser och resultat på ett begripligt sätt för verksamheten


ML Engineer

Du arbetar i gränslandet mellan Data Science och Data Engineering, med fokus på att få modeller och AI-lösningar att fungera i produktion – från experiment och PoC till skalbara produktionslösningar. Du arbetar med:
Att ta modeller framtagna av Data Scientists och göra dem produktionsklara
Att bygga lösningar för att träna, deploya och köra modeller automatiskt
Att säkerställa att modeller fungerar i produktion, med hänsyn till exempelvis latens och skalbarhet
Att övervaka modeller och följa drift, datadrift och prestanda över tid


Du blir en viktig del i att hjälpa organisationer att utnyttja digitaliseringens möjligheter, från effektivisering till helt nya arbetssätt.

Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av
Minst 4 års arbete som Data Scientist, ML Engineer, dataanalytiker eller inom AI/ML-roller
Avancerad dataanalys och AI/ML-modeller – till exempel prediktion, klassificering, klustring eller produktionssättning av modeller, beroende på om din profil ligger mer åt Data Scientist eller ML Engineer
Python eller R
Versionshantering (Git)
Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift

Beroende på vilken profil du känner dig mest hemma i väger vi även in:
Data Scientist: erfarenhet av bibliotek som scikit-learn, pandas/polars eller statsmodels, samt datavisualisering med Matplotlib, Seaborn eller BI-verktyg som Power BI
ML Engineer: erfarenhet av TensorFlow/PyTorch, containerteknik (Docker, Kubernetes) och verktyg för MLOps som MLflow


Det viktigaste för oss är inte en checklista av verktyg, utan att du faktiskt har arbetat med avancerad analys och modeller, eller med att sätta modeller och AI-lösningar i produktion.

Meriterande om du även har
Kunskap om informationssäkerhet, GDPR och etisk AI
Erfarenhet av Azure, AWS eller andra molntjänster, exempelvis Azure ML, SageMaker eller Databricks
API-integrationer och arbete med data från flera olika källor
Vana av RAG-lösningar, agenter och ramverk som LangChain, LangGraph eller LlamaIndex


Teamet du blir en del av

Du blir en del av vårt team inom Dataanalys & BI med konsulter i både Luleå och Stockholm. Här möter du kollegor som brinner för sitt område, som hjälper varandra att utvecklas och som tillsammans bygger lösningar från ax till limpa.

Området är prioriterat hos oss, och du kommer att spela en viktig roll i teamets fortsatta utveckling. Samtidigt får du en personlig och skräddarsydd utvecklingsresa där du tillsammans med teamet stärker Agios affär och skapar värde för våra kunder.

Varför Agio?

Agio erbjuder dig:
Trygghet genom kollektivavtal och stabila kundrelationer
En arbetsplats som värnar om balans i livet
En personlig kompetensresa där du får utvecklas i din riktning
En platt organisation där du får stort inflytande
Ett företag som satsar långsiktigt både på dig och våra kunder


Vill du växa med oss? Skicka in en ansökan genom att svara på några korta frågor nedan.

Title: Bolags- och leverantörsanalytiker
Description:
Vi söker en analytiker som vill se det andra missar




Vilka står egentligen bakom ett bolag? Hänger företagets ekonomi, ägarbild och verksamhet ihop? Finns det kopplingar eller avvikelser som en beställare behöver känna till innan en leverantör anlitas?




Moxy söker en analytiker inom bolags- och leverantörsgranskning till vårt team i Stockholm.




Det här är en kvalificerad och utmanande roll för dig som vill kombinera ekonomisk analys med undersökande arbete. Du granskar svenska och utländska bolag, följer ägarstrukturer och identifierar samband, avvikelser och riskindikatorer som annars kan vara svåra att upptäcka.




Moxy genomför även kontroller av rättslig bakgrund hos relevanta personer. Arbetet bedrivs med stor respekt för den personliga integriteten och inom ramen för gällande lagstiftning och Moxys tillstånd från Integritetsskyddsmyndigheten.




Dina analyser blir konkreta beslutsunderlag för stora företag och offentliga organisationer. De hjälper våra kunder att fatta tryggare beslut, välja seriösa leverantörer och förebygga fusk, osund konkurrens och arbetslivskriminalitet.

Vi arbetar i ett högt tempo, ofta med komplexa frågeställningar och höga krav på kvalitet, noggrannhet och leverans. Du får arbeta nära några av Sveriges stora företag och organisationer, där dina bedömningar kan få direkt betydelse för kundernas beslut.

Title: Senior Data Engineer
Description:
Techster Solutions befinner i dagsläget sig i en spännande tillväxtfas och söker nu fler kollegor, inledningsvis dig med minst 3+ års erfarenhet och som kan stärka teamet.

Du kan förvänta dig en omväxlande miljö, dagarna kan se väldigt olika ut - men en sak är säkert, här får du använda dina kompetenser och sätter själv gränsen för hur mycket du vill utvecklas. Som ett kunskapsbolag är det viktigt för oss att våra specialister delar med sig av sin kompetens och får kollegorna att växa.

Rollbeskrivning:

Vi söker nu en senior Data Engineer.

Uppdragsbeskrivning:

Kund söker en driven och framåtsträvande senior data engineer till Digitaliseringsenheten. Enheten ingår i avdelningen för verksamhetsstöd och ansvarar för verksamhetsnära digitala lösningar som stöder myndighetens kärnverksamhet.

Digitaliseringsenheten arbetar agilt i fyra utvecklingsteam och präglas av innovation, nytänkande och höga ambitioner.

Som senior data engineer blir du en nyckelperson i utvecklingen och förvaltningen av vårt datalager och våra BI-lösningar. Du kommer att driva tekniska beslut, optimera dataprocesser och säkerställa robusta, långsiktiga lösningar som skapar värde för verksamheten samt analysera och lösa komplexa problem på djupet.

Placering: kunds kontor i Stockholm men med möjlighet till visst distansarbete.

Arbetsuppgifter


Designa, utveckla och underhålla datalager, ETL-flöden och SSAS-kuber för rapportering och analys.
Bygga datamodeller i SSAS som möjliggör effektiva och användarvänliga Power BI-lösningar.
Felsöka, analysera och lösa komplexa problem i datalager och dataprocesser, från rotorsak till färdig lösning.
Driva tekniska beslut kring arkitektur, datamodellering, datakvalitet och optimering av kuber.
Samarbeta nära verksamheten för att förstå behov och omvandla dem till datadrivna beslutsstöd.
Coachning och mentorskap av kollegor i teamet, inklusive standardisering av kod och processer.
Bidra till en insiktsdriven myndighet genom att identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter och föreslå nya lösningar.


Krav

Skallkrav:


Relevant högskoleutbildning inom systemvetenskap, datavetenskap eller annan teknisk utbildning som bedöms relevant.
Minst 3–5 års erfarenhet som data engineer med fokus på datalager, ETL, BI-lösningar eller motsvarande.
Mycket goda kunskaper i SSAS (SQL Server Analysis Services) och erfarenhet av att bygga kuber, datamodeller och measures för analys och rapportering.
Mycket goda kunskaper i SQL och erfarenhet av att skriva och optimera komplexa queries.
Erfarenhet av Microsoft SQL Server on-prem, inklusive Management Studio och databasadministration på utvecklingsnivå.
God förståelse för datamodellering och databasdesign (t.ex. 3NF och Kimball).
Vana vid Git och versionshantering, samt dokumentation av kod och dataprocesser.
Mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på svenska.
Utvärdering av de personliga egenskaperna kommer att ske vid en eventuell intervju


Börkrav:


Erfarenhet av att arbeta i agila team och nära kärnverksamheten.
Erfarenhet av att driva förbättringar inom datakvalitet, datastyrning och best practices.


Ansökan

Tror du att du är Techster Solutions nästa stjärna? Tveka då inte att skicka in din ansökan redan nu. Urval sker löpande och tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse.

Arbetsplats och kultur

Vi är ett entreprenördrivet IT företag, med både produktkunskap och försäljning (Techster AB) och konsultativa tjänster (Techster Solutions AB). Det innebär att vi är mycket öppna för nya tekniska lösningar, kunskapsutbyte och ständigt lärande. Att ha roligt och samtidigt behålla den familjära andan utan hierarkier är lika viktigt.

Vi vill skapa det konsultbolag som du alltid velat jobba för, men kanske inte hittat ännu. Redan idag har vi en blandning av seniora och yngre medarbetare, såväl som män och kvinnor. Det vill vi fortsätta att bygga på. Så välkommen med din ansökan!

Title: Forskningsassistent
Description:
Statsvetenskapliga institutionen är en dynamisk och stark utbildning- och forskningsinstitution vid Samhällsvetenskapliga fakulteten vid Stockholms universitet. Institutionen strävar efter att vara nationellt ledande och internationellt framstående inom forskning och utbildning.



Statsvetenskapliga institutionen har drygt 90 medarbetare och omkring 1000 studenter. 



Mer information om oss finns på: Statsvetenskapliga institutionen.



Arbetsuppgifter



Insamling och bearbetning av data inom forskningsprojektet ”Att förklara framgång i lagstiftningsarbetet i parlamentariska demokratier”. Digitalisering, kodning och analys av skriftliga dokument relaterade till valkampanjer och lagstiftningsprocessen i Sverige och andra länder.



Kvalifikationer



Den sökande ska ha en kandidatexamen i statsvetenskap eller liknande samhällsvetenskapligt ämne. God svenska och engelska i tal och skrift är ett krav. Det krävs även god förtrogenhet med Excel samt grundläggande förtrogenhet med statistikprogrammet Stata. Det är meriterande med mastersexamen, dokumenterad erfarenhet av forskningsassistentarbete, gärna med en hög grad av självständighet, samt genomgången kurs och betyg i kvantitativa metoder på avancerad nivå.



Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet.



Om anställningen



Anställningen avser antingen heltid i tre månader, eller halvtid i sex månader. Stockholms universitet tillämpar individuell lönesättning. Tillträde snarast eller enligt överenskommelse.



Vi erbjuder



Hos oss får du dynamiken i samspelet mellan högre utbildning och forskning som gör Stockholms universitet till en spännande och kreativ miljö. Du arbetar i en internationell miljö och får förmånliga villkor. Universitetet ligger beläget i Nationalstadsparken med goda förbindelser till city.



Stockholms universitet värnar om att vara en arbetsplats som är fri från diskriminering och ger lika rättigheter och möjligheter för alla.



Kontakt



Ytterligare information lämnas av professor Jan Teorell, jan.teorell@statsvet.su.se.



Ansökan



Du söker anställningen via Stockholms universitets rekryteringssystem. Du som sökande ansvarar för att ansökan är komplett och att den är universitetet tillhanda senast sista ansökningsdag.



Anvisningar för sökande finns på webbsidan: att söka en anställning.



Stockholms universitet bidrar till det hållbara demokratiska samhällets utveckling genom kunskap, upplysning och sanningssökande.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Data Analyst




We are looking for a technical Data Analyst to own the data integrity, ingestion pipelines, and interface monitoring for a high-priority corporate optimization platform. This role acts as the bridge between raw corporate systems and machine learning engines. You will lead the profiling, cleansing, and normalization of multiple fragmented data streams, ensuring data quality remains absolute before feeding predictive models




Key Responsibilities

Multi-Source Data Profiling: Ingest, analyze, and map fields across diverse, complex enterprise datasets, systematically identifying gaps, structural inconsistencies, and duplicate operational records
Data Quality & Monitoring: Design, configure, and maintain automated data validation checks and alerting pipelines to immediately catch anomalies or schema drift
Interface Management: Define the operational data mapping logic required to translate and normalize disparate terms across multiple corporate records into a unified organizational taxonomy
Data Storytelling: Create high-impact dashboards and visualizations to track data readiness, system health scores, and initial descriptive statistics for key project stakeholders




Required Technical Skills

Experience: Hands-on experience as a Data Analyst, Systems Analyst, or Data Integration Specialist within a complex, matrixed technical environment
Python Automation: Strong Python coding skills, with a heavy emphasis on using the core data-handling ecosystem (pandas, NumPy) to clean, reshape, and merge highly fractured data tables
SQL Mastery: Exceptional ability to write production-ready, complex SQL queries, subqueries, and window functions to pull and verify data from multiple relational schemas
Quality Frameworks: Direct experience setting up automated validation systems or custom data monitoring frameworks. Proficiency with visualization platforms (Power BI, Tableau) for tracking operational health metrics is required

Title: Pricing Analyst
Description:
About Pikl

Pikl is on a mission to enable the growth of digital marketplaces, starting with vacation rentals. We design and deliver insurance-enabled solutions that help platforms, property managers and owners unlock new revenue and deliver better customer experiences.

Founded in 2016, we began by protecting individual hosts and homeowners with specialist holiday-let cover. That experience now powers our insurance-enabled products, which increase participation, lift conversion and drive revenue across the marketplace value chain: platforms, homeowners and guests.

With offices in Norwich and London, and plans for international expansion, we work with some of the most recognised brands in travel as well as major insurance aggregators.

About The Role

Supporting the Pricing and Underwriting team in the delivery of pricing activity across Pikl's insurance products and partnerships. The role is responsible for pricing analysis, portfolio monitoring and supporting the development of pricing models to ensure sustainable and profitable growth.

Working collaboratively with Underwriting, Product, Claims and Partnership teams to understand performance drivers, identify opportunities and support pricing decision making. Supporting the pricing of new schemes and products, ongoing portfolio management and the continued development of pricing capability across the business.

Key Responsibilities


Support the development, maintenance and enhancement of actuarial pricing models across Pikl products.
Conduct pricing and portfolio analysis to identify trends, opportunities and areas of concern.
Monitor product and portfolio performance, including premium adequacy, loss ratios, rating performance and profitability.
Support the pricing of new products, schemes and partnership opportunities.
Produce pricing analyses, reports and recommendations to support business decision making.
Work closely with Underwriting, Claims, Product and Partnerships teams to understand portfolio performance and drivers of risk.
Support the ongoing monitoring and validation of pricing models and rating structures.
Contribute to the assessment and integration of internal and external data sources.
Undertake competitor and market analysis to support pricing recommendations.
Support the development of pricing processes, tools and reporting capabilities.
Ensure pricing activity complies with regulatory requirements and fair value principles.
Be a source of pricing and pricing delivery support within the business.


About You


2+ years experience in insurance pricing.
Ability to maintain, enhance and validate pricing models and provide judgement to stakeholders.
2 years + actuarial experience
Strong Excel skills.
Experience of analysing large datasets and identifying trends and insights.
Ability to interpret data and translate findings into practical recommendations.
Good communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
Ability to manage competing priorities and work effectively within a fast-paced environment.
Collaborative approach with the ability to build relationships across teams.
Experience within General Insurance pricing.
Experience of using SQL, R, Python or similar for data extraction and analysis
Experience using pricing software such as Earnix, Radar or Hx is desirable.
Understanding of insurance pricing concepts and portfolio performance metrics.
Exposure to predictive modelling, GLM (Generalised Liner Models) or GBM (Gradient Boosting Models) is desirable
Experience working within an MGA, delegated authority or capacity-backed environment is desirable.


Our Values

At Pikl, our values are the foundation on which our success is built. They guide how we work together, how we make decisions for customers and colleagues, and what we recognise and reward.

Possibility

We think big and are fearless in turning challenges into opportunities. We stay curious, test ideas and learn quickly.

People

We put people first, building relationships rooted in empathy and trust. We respect, include, and learn from one another. We celebrate progress.

Progress

We unlock growth opportunities for our customers and each other yet make it our personal responsibility to own actions and see them through.

Access to an incredible working space in Norwich and London
Annual leave entitlement of 28 days, plus bank holidays

About The Role

Supporting the Pricing and Underwriting team in the delivery of pricing activity across Pikl's insurance products and partnerships. The role is responsible for pricing analysis, portfolio monitoring and supporting the development of pricing models to ensure sustainable and profitable growth.

Working collaboratively with Underwriting, Product, Claims and Partnership teams to understand performance drivers, identify opportunities and support pricing decision making. Supporting the pricing of new schemes and products, ongoing portfolio management and the continued development of pricing capability across the business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the development, maintenance and enhancement of actuarial pricing models across Pikl products.
  • Conduct pricing and portfolio analysis to identify trends, opportunities and areas of concern.
  • Monitor product and portfolio performance, including premium adequacy, loss ratios, rating performance and profitability.
  • Support the pricing of new products, schemes and partnership opportunities.
  • Produce pricing analyses, reports and recommendations to support business decision making.
  • Work closely with Underwriting, Claims, Product and Partnerships teams to understand portfolio performance and drivers of risk.
  • Support the ongoing monitoring and validation of pricing models and rating structures.
  • Contribute to the assessment and integration of internal and external data sources.
  • Undertake competitor and market analysis to support pricing recommendations.
  • Support the development of pricing processes, tools and reporting capabilities.
  • Ensure pricing activity complies with regulatory requirements and fair value principles.
  • Be a source of pricing and pricing delivery support within the business.

About You

  • 2+ years experience in insurance pricing.
  • Ability to maintain, enhance and validate pricing models and provide judgement to stakeholders.
  • 2 years + actuarial experience
  • Strong Excel skills.

Team - Data and Information Services

Demonstrated Data Governance Expertise
Strong Data Quality Analysis
Proven Stakeholder Partnership


What this role is all about:

We're looking for a confident and influential communicator to join our Data Governance team as a Data Governance Analyst. In this role, you'll work closely with stakeholders across the business, engaging and challenging where needed to drive high standards of data governance, improve data quality, and ensure Vitality's data remains trusted, protected and fit for strategic decision-making.

Key Actions


Support the implementation and continuous improvement of the Data Governance Framework to strengthen data quality, integrity and business value
Analyse data processes and work with Data Owners and Data Stewards to identify and resolve data quality issues at source
Conduct data profiling and implement data quality controls to improve the accuracy and reliability of business data
Produce data quality reporting and dashboards, highlighting risks and supporting governance decision-making
Coordinate and support data governance forums, including preparing packs, recording actions and tracking outcomes
Build effective relationships with stakeholders across the business to promote good data management practices
Champion data governance standards and support colleagues in embedding governance requirements within their areas
Maintain data catalogues, business glossaries and data dictionaries to improve understanding and accessibility of data assets
Support the governance of information assets through classification, retention and lifecycle management activities
Contribute to the development of a strong data culture by promoting best practice and continuous improvement across the organisation


What do you need to thrive?


Experience working within data governance, data management or data quality environments
Strong data analysis skills with the ability to identify trends, issues and root causes
Knowledge of data management tools, ideally Collibra, including glossary and classification management
Experience working with insurance or financial services data would be advantageous
Ability to interrogate and profile data, with SQL skills highly desirable
Strong stakeholder management skills and the confidence to engage with audiences at all levels
Good understanding of data governance, data security, privacy and information lifecycle principles
A proactive mindset with a passion for improving data quality and driving best practice across the business


So, what’s in it for you?


Bonus Schemes - A bonus that regularly rewards you for your performance

Our award-winning Vitality health insurance - With its own set of rewards and benefits

Be there for you when you need us
Provide opportunities for you to be a force for good in society


We commit to all these things because we want you to feel that you belong, and are supported to be happy and healthy.

Title: Insight Analyst
Description:
Insight Analyst

Location: Bath - Once or twice a month onsite
Salary: £45,000 - £55,000 plus benefits

Organisation Overview:

Our Client is a dynamic organisation operating within the data and analytics industry, renowned for driving innovative solutions and strategic insights to empower clients across various sectors. Known for a vibrant company culture, continuous growth, and a focus on professional development, they are committed to creating an inclusive and collaborative environment. Embracing innovation and fostering talent, their workplace offers excellent benefits and opportunities for career progression.

The Opportunity

We're looking for an Insight Analyst to join a growing Intelligent Data team, delivering high-quality analytical insight for clients across the commercial and not-for-profit sectors.

This is a hands-on role combining core insight work with opportunities to apply data science. You'll work on projects ranging from audits, campaign analysis and segmentation through to propensity modelling, lifetime value forecasting and attribution.

You'll have the opportunity to work directly with clients, shape analytical approaches, develop new tools and solutions, and turn complex data into clear recommendations that drive action.

What We're Looking For

Essential



Strong SQL skills, including complex joins and performance tuning across large datasets.
At least two years' experience using Python or R to solve client or business problems.
Understanding of at least one data science technique relevant to fundraising, such as propensity modelling, lifetime value or segmentation-led forecasting.
Experience managing the analytical relationship for a small portfolio of client accounts.
Confidence designing an analytical approach independently, without requiring senior sign-off for every brief.
The ability to interpret analytical output and communicate recommendations that clients can act on.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with confidence presenting findings to clients.
A structured approach to unfamiliar analytical problems, with the ability to develop and justify an appropriate solution.
Excellent attention to detail.
The ability to manage a varied insight and data science workload independently.



What You Can Expect

You'll join a collaborative, data-focused environment where analytical thinking, curiosity and practical problem-solving are valued. The role offers scope to develop your technical expertise while also building your client-facing and commercial skills.

You'll work on varied projects, have genuine ownership of your analysis and be encouraged to contribute ideas that improve both client outcomes and the way the team works.

Interested in hearing more? Please get in touch with Rebecca Long on 0117 332 8100 / r.long @ ioassociates.co.uk

Description:
Company Description

Version 1 has celebrated 30 years in business and continues to be trusted by global brands to deliver technology and transformation solutions that drive customer success. Our deep expertise enables our customers to navigate the rapidly evolving technology landscape. We foster strong partnerships with global technology leaders including Microsoft, AWS, Oracle, Red Hat, OutSystems, Snowflake, ensuring that our customers are provided with the highest quality solutions and services.

 We’re an award-winning employer reflecting how our employees are at the very heart of what we do:


UK & Ireland's premier AWS, Microsoft & Oracle partner
3300+ strong, €350/£300m revenue business
10+ years as a Great Place to Work in Ireland & UK
Best Workplace for Women in the UK & Ireland by GPTW
Best Workplace for Wellbeing in the UK by GPTW


We’re a core values driven company, we hire people who share our values, and we reward those who display and foster them, it’s deeply embedded within our DNA. Invest in us and we’ll invest in you!.

Job Description

Our Analytics team sits within the UCD & Insights Capability, which consists of User Research, Content Design, Interaction & UX Design and Analytics. We primarily work in the public sector, supporting initiatives that improve society and the lives of citizens; with not-for-profit organisations, charities and social enterprises; and with some private-sector companies. The key sectors we're working in at the moment include education, apprenticeships & skills development, social care, rehabilitation, housing and criminal justice.

We Are Looking For An Analytics Professional Who Values


Measuring what matters, not just what is measurable;
Solving the right problem;
Simple and explainable solutions;
Learning a diverse range of technical skills;
Developing insights and stories in partnership with stakeholders;
Empowering our clients through training and improved data literacy;
Collaboration with each other and our clients, constructive feedback and questions;
Repeatable, reliable, automated and sufficiently documented processes, not just getting repetitive work


Skills

In this role you will deliver excellent data analysis and visualisation services for clients. You would join a multi-disciplinary client team along with their own employees, other consultants/contractors. Your exact role would depend on their needs and your technical skills and experience. You might:


Build dashboards in a tool like Looker Studio, Power BI or Amazon QuickSight
Write SQL queries to transform data into a form useful for further analysis or visualisation
Use SQL (or optionally Python) to analyse data
Work with others with different roles and skillsets to develop meaningful insights that transform their decision making – for example about government policy, digital product strategy or user experience
Define, analyse and visualise a government digital service’s KPIs and goals (known as ‘performance analysis’ in the UK public sector


Influence and inspire clients to take informed strategic decisions about their approach to analytics – advising on tools, how to make data available, outcomes, governance, people, skills etc. You won’t do everything yourself and will need to work with others who can complement the gaps in your own knowledge and experience.

Be an active member of the analytics community of practice – taking part in training and development activities and sharing your own skills and experience.

Depending on your skills and preferences, you might take on additional coaching and training responsibilities such as becoming a performance coach, providing informal on the job support or delivering more formal training activities.

This role requires eligibility for Security Check (SC) clearance.

To be eligible, you must have the right to work in the UK and will have resided in the UK for at least 5 years.

Qualifications

We’ll assess the following skills during the application process:


SQL. You have used more advanced SQL (for example, complex joins between combinations of tables and CTEs, analytic functions, regular expressions, scripting and/or arrays/nested data) for data analysis.
Data visualisation. You are an experienced user of a data visualisation tool (e.g. Looker Studio, Looker, Power BI, Tableau, Amazon QuickSight) to visualise data and can describe the data stories this has enabled you to tell.
Enabling data driven decision-making. You have a proven track record of breaking down the barriers that prevent a team from doing this effectively. Sometimes you have done this through application of your own technical skills. Sometimes you have delivered this through empowering and influencing others to bring skills and experience that complement your own.
Building and managing relationships. You can build and maintain strong relationships, demonstrating strong emotional intelligence and recognising the different needs of the diverse range of team members and clients. You have experience mediating and mending relationships and managing expectations of clients and stakeholders.
Communication. You have strong listening, verbal and written communication skills, which you can leverage to build relationships and facilitate effectively, asking the right questions to ensure conversations remain focused. You have experience communicating sensitive messages, telling nuanced data stories and navigating difficult conversations, steering these towards positive outcomes.
Adaptability. You can adjust your approach, including technical decisions, leadership approach and role to suit different client contexts and team needs.


Additional Information

At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability.


Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits
Strong Career Progression & mentorship coaching through our Strength in Balance & Leadership schemes with a dedicated quarterly Pathways Career Development programme
Flexible/remote working, Version 1 is tremendously understanding of life events and people’s individual circumstances and offer flexibility to help achieve a healthy work life balance
Financial Wellbeing initiatives including; Version 1 Pension with a 5% employee-matched contribution, Private Healthcare Cover, Life Assurance, Financial advice and an Employee Discount scheme
Employee Wellbeing schemes including Gym Discounts, Bike to Work, Fitness classes, Mindfulness Workshops, Employee Assistance Programme and much more.
24 days holiday allowance plus Public Holidays, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, marriage/civil partnership leave and special leave policies
Educational assistance, incentivised certifications, and accreditations, including AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, and Red Hat
Reward schemes including Version 1’s Annual Excellence Awards & quarterly Star Awards.
Environment, Social and Community First initiatives allow you to get involved in local fundraising and development opportunities as part of fostering our diversity, inclusion and belonging schemes.


And many more exciting benefits… drop us a note to find out more.

Version 1 is an equal opportunities employer

We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels valued and able to thrive. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and lived experiences, and we value the different perspectives people bring including those shaped by disability and neurodiversity.

We want every candidate to have a positive and accessible recruitment experience. If you need reasonable adjustments at any stage of the process, please contact Ashley.Smith@version1.com at Version 1. We will consider all requests carefully, respectfully and confidentially.

  • Build dashboards in a tool like Looker Studio, Power BI or Amazon QuickSight
  • Write SQL queries to transform data into a form useful for further analysis or visualisation
  • Use SQL (or optionally Python) to analyse data
  • Work with others with different roles and skillsets to develop meaningful insights that transform their decision making – for example about government policy, digital product strategy or user experience
  • Define, analyse and visualise a government digital service’s KPIs and goals (known as ‘performance analysis’ in the UK public sector

Influence and inspire clients to take informed strategic decisions about their approach to analytics – advising on tools, how to make data available, outcomes, governance, people, skills etc. You won’t do everything yourself and will need to work with others who can complement the gaps in your own knowledge and experience.

Be an active member of the analytics community of practice – taking part in training and development activities and sharing your own skills and experience.

Depending on your skills and preferences, you might take on additional coaching and training responsibilities such as becoming a performance coach, providing informal on the job support or delivering more formal training activities.

This role requires eligibility for Security Check (SC) clearance.

To be eligible, you must have the right to work in the UK and will have resided in the UK for at least 5 years.

Qualifications

We’ll assess the following skills during the application process:

  • SQL. You have used more advanced SQL (for example, complex joins between combinations of tables and CTEs, analytic functions, regular expressions, scripting and/or arrays/nested data) for data analysis.
  • Data visualisation. You are an experienced user of a data visualisation tool (e.g. Looker Studio, Looker, Power BI, Tableau, Amazon QuickSight) to visualise data and can describe the data stories this has enabled you to tell.
  • Enabling data driven decision-making. You have a proven track record of breaking down the barriers that prevent a team from doing this effectively. Sometimes you have done this through application of your own technical skills. Sometimes you have delivered this through empowering and influencing others to bring skills and experience that complement your own.
  • Building and managing relationships. You can build and maintain strong relationships, demonstrating strong emotional intelligence and recognising the different needs of the diverse range of team members and clients. You have experience mediating and mending relationships and managing expectations of clients and stakeholders.
  • Communication. You have strong listening, verbal and written communication skills, which you can leverage to build relationships and facilitate effectively, asking the right questions to ensure conversations remain focused. You have experience communicating sensitive messages, telling nuanced data stories and navigating difficult conversations, steering these towards positive outcomes.
  • Adaptability. You can adjust your approach, including technical decisions, leadership approach and role to suit different client contexts and team needs.

Additional Information

At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability.

  • Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits
  • Strong Career Progression & mentorship coaching through our Strength in Balance & Leadership schemes with a dedicated quarterly Pathways Career Development programme
  • Flexible/remote working, Version 1 is tremendously understanding of life events and people’s individual circumstances and offer flexibility to help achieve a healthy work life balance
  • Financial Wellbeing initiatives including; Version 1 Pension with a 5% employee-matched contribution, Private Healthcare Cover, Life Assurance, Financial advice and an Employee Discount scheme
  • Employee Wellbeing schemes including Gym Discounts, Bike to Work, Fitness classes, Mindfulness Workshops, Employee Assistance Programme and much more.

  • Reward schemes including Version 1’s Annual Excellence Awards & quarterly Star Awards.

And many more exciting benefits… drop us a note to find out more.

Do you enjoy turning complex supply chain data into meaningful insights that improve planning, inventory and operational performance?

We're supporting a leading manufacturing business in Fareham who are looking to recruit a Supply Chain Data Analyst to join their Supply Chain team.

What's the role all about?

As a Supply Chain Data Analyst, you'll play a key role in maintaining, analysing and improving supply chain data to support effective planning and operational decision-making.

Working closely with Supply Chain, Purchasing, Production and Operations teams, you'll ensure data integrity across ERP systems while producing meaningful reports and identifying opportunities to improve business performance.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys combining analytical thinking with practical problem solving within a manufacturing environment.

Maintain and validate supply chain master data within ERP systems
Analyse supply chain data to identify trends, risks and improvement opportunities
Produce regular KPI reports and performance dashboards
Support inventory management and stock optimisation activities
Ensure Bills of Materials (BOMs), part numbers and planning data remain accurate
Work closely with Planning, Purchasing, Production and Engineering teams
Investigate data discrepancies and implement corrective actions
Support forecasting, scheduling and demand planning activities
Develop reports using Excel and business reporting tools
Drive continuous improvement in data quality and reporting processes

Ensure data governance and documentation standards are maintained

Experience within a Supply Chain, Planning or Data Analyst role
Previous experience working within a manufacturing environment
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills
Experience working with ERP/MRP systems
Excellent attention to detail
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment


Desirable


Experience using Power BI, SQL or other reporting tools
Knowledge of production planning and inventory control
Understanding of manufacturing processes
Experience supporting continuous improvement projects
Exposure to Lean Manufacturing principles

You're naturally analytical and enjoy using data to solve problems and improve business performance.

You'll Be


Highly organised
Detail-oriented
Curious and proactive
A confident communicator
Comfortable working with large volumes of data
Passionate about continuous improvement

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a growing manufacturing business where you'll play a key role in improving supply chain performance and supporting operational excellence.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Company Description

Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.

Job Description

We are looking for a Data Analyst reporting into the Head of Data in our Nottingham office. You will manage the delivery of high-quality data solutions that support client, operational, and business objectives. Working within the Data Delivery team, you will combine technical capability with stakeholder engagement to ensure data products are delivered accurately, efficiently.

You can analyse, transform, and validate complex datasets using SQL or SAS, while identifying opportunities to improve processes, mitigate risks, and enhance existing data products. Experience with Python, R, VBA, or other modern data tooling would be advantageous.

As a key member of the team, the Data Analyst acts as a trusted partner to stakeholders. You will translate business requirements into data solutions, managing delivery expectations, and ensuring a high standard of customer service throughout the delivery lifecycle.

You will also play an important part in developing team capability through mentoring, knowledge sharing, and supporting the growth of junior analysts.

Key Responsibilities


You will build strong working relationships with internal and external stakeholders, developing a clear understanding of their business requirements and objectives.
Translate stakeholder requirements into effective data deliverables and solutions.
Manage client expectations and proactively address queries, issues, and risks.
Deliver excellent customer outcomes by ensuring solutions are accurate, valuable, and fit for purpose.


Data Delivery & Analysis


Own and deliver data extracts, reports, and analytical outputs to agreed quality, scope, and timelines.
Use SQL, SAS, and other analytical tools to interrogate, manipulate, and validate complex datasets.
Apply robust validation and quality assurance processes to all deliverables.
Investigate data-related issues and client queries, conducting root cause analysis and communicating findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Support the delivery of proof-of-concepts, new products, and data-driven solutions.


Operational Excellence


Plan, prioritise, and manage workload across multiple deliveries and projects.
Provide accurate effort estimates and delivery timescales.
Monitor progress against commitments and escalate risks or issues.
Identify opportunities to improve delivery processes, increase efficiency, and reduce operational risk.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of team practices, documentation, and standards.


Governance, Risk & Compliance


Ensure all deliveries comply with regulatory, contractual, and internal governance requirements.
Maintain awareness of data protection, security, and compliance obligations.
Identify, assess, and help mitigate operational and delivery risks.
Support audit, governance, and control activities where required.


Collaboration & Leadership


Support and coach junior team members, sharing technical expertise and best practice.
Lead or actively contribute to delivery reviews, project discussions, and problem-solving sessions.
Champion knowledge sharing and continuous learning across the team.


Qualifications


Strong SQL and/or SAS programming skills.
Experience working with complex datasets and data transformation processes.
Strong analytical skills.
You can engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience investigating and resolving data-related issues.


Desirable


Experience with Python, R, VBA, or other data technologies.
Experience delivering data solutions in a client-facing environment.
Knowledge of data governance, quality management, and regulatory requirements.
Experience mentoring or supporting junior colleagues.
Experience working within project or change delivery environments.


Additional Information

Benefits package includes:


Hybrid working - 40% office based
Great compensation package and uncapped commission
Core benefits include pension, bupa healthcare, sharesave scheme and more!
25 days annual leave with 8 bank holidays and 3 volunteering days. You can also purchase additional annual leave.


Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's people first, inclusive and purpose driven culture is multi award-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25), Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or explore our Careers Site to understand why. Experian is also proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.

Title: Performance Analyst
Description:
Hereford & Worcester Fire and Rescue Service,

Scale SO2

£37,280 – £39,152 per annum

Full time, 37 hours per week

Permanent

Based at Worcester Fire Station

The Role

A permanent opportunity has arisen in the Performance and Information department, which is currently based at Worcester Fire Station, for a Performance Analyst.

The post holder will be responsible for managing, analysing and providing performance information for Hereford & Worcester Fire and Rescue Service and external agencies, enabling the organisation to continually improve and manage risk data.

The Person

Although the ideal applicant will be in possession of a degree Level 6 qualification in relevant discipline (e.g. information management, statistics, programming, geography), this is not an essential requirement for the post. We welcome applications from professionals having equivalent knowledge and skills gained through work experience in similar roles.

Experience and knowledge:


Significant administrative experience in managing a database on a daily basis.
Understanding the relationships between large and complex datasets to identify the drivers behind performance changes.
Using a wide range of programmes and reporting tools for analytical purposes, e.g. mapping software, statistical software, data visualisation software.
Excellent numerical skills and proven ability to assimilate, analyse, interpret and present data.
Ability to identify problems and suggest and implement solutions.
Good communication skills to explain complex analytical outputs and to deliver training, when required.
Proven ability to manage multiple competing priorities simultaneously.
Evidence of continuous professional development.



About Us

Every day we are helping to save lives and keep the community safe - and not only by fighting fires. Behind the scenes at Hereford & Worcester Fire and Rescue Service, there are many other roles that people do not see, helping to provide vital functions to keep us an efficient and effective Fire and Rescue Service.

Reasons to Join Us


29 days annual leave entitlement increasing to 34 days after five years’ continuous service (plus bank holidays).
Access to the Local Government Pension scheme.
Flexi-time scheme allowing you to have an element of flexibility over your working hours and hybrid working is available.
Free car parking at Service Headquarters and across our 25 fire stations.
Access to an on-site gym.
Access to the Blue Light Card – the UK’s largest Emergency Services discount card.
Access to the Firefighters Charity welfare support.



Please ensure you have read the candidate guidance notes attached to this advert.

The closing date for applications is 11:59pm on Sunday 13th September 2026.

Interviews will be held w/c 21st September 2026.

The successful applicant will be subject to pre-employment checks including a standard DBS check and a social media screening check.

For any further queries regarding the role, please contact Henry Bowen, Performance & Information Manager (hbowen@hwfire.org.uk 07827 990427).
