Title: Graduate Business Operations Associate
Description:
About Us

Bezos.ai is a Fulfilment-as-a-Service (FaaS) platform. Online sellers connect their sales channels (Amazon, eBay, Shopify) and we orchestrate the rest: routing orders to a global network of warehouse and carrier partners, tracking every parcel to the customer's door, and giving sellers one clean view of their entire supply chain. We are a small, fast-moving, AI-native team that is almost doubling our business in 2026. Operations is the engine room, and this is where you learn how a real logistics platform runs: fast, with real ownership from day one.

Your Mission

Be the dependable engine of the ops team. You'll keep orders flowing - spotting and resolving the ones that get stuck or go missing - answer seller and operational queries, run our operational checks, and help build the AI skills and automations that take the repetitive work off everyone's plate. You'll learn the whole order journey end-to-end and, within months, start figuring things out on your own.

Core Pillars


Keep the flow clean: Run the daily cross-system checks; spot orders that are missing, stuck or mismatched, and resolve or escalate them.
Support sellers & partners: Answer operational tickets, run checkers, and create/send invoices accurately and on time.
Learn to build: Use Claude to build skills and automations that remove repetitive work, starting with the recruitment exercise and growing from there.
Improve as you go: Drive incremental improvements to the tools and processes you touch every day.


What You'll Achieve In Your First 90 Days


Run the daily cross-system reconciliation reliably and clear order exceptions in your queue.
Answer operational tickets within SLA and run the Bezos checkers independently.
Build your first working Claude skill or small automation that saves the team time.
Deliver clean, on-time work on a team project and start figuring out open-ended tasks with less hand-holding.


Requirements

What we're looking for (non-negotiables)


Numerate & analytical. A degree (or clearly demonstrated equivalent) in a quantitative discipline, eg engineering, maths, physics, CS, or a heavily numerate economics / finance / quant-social-science track. Comfortable with raw data and spreadsheets.
AI-native: can build, not just chat. You use Claude/AI in your daily work and can build a simple, working Claude skill. You don't need a portfolio of production agents yet, but you must demonstrate building one in the recruitment exercise. (Having already built skills/agents is a strong plus.)
Reliable & coachable. Delivers what's asked, on time, with clean work; asks questions when stuck rather than guessing; takes feedback well.
Picks things up fast. Learns new tools and processes quickly and gets productive without a long ramp.
Energised by startups. Excited by ambiguity, pace and ownership, wants a wide remit, not a narrow one.
Clear communicator. Writes clearly, presents simple findings, and flags problems early.


Nice-to-haves


Internships or part-time work in consulting, banking, operations, analytics, consulting, e-commerce or a startup.
Light coding (Python / SQL) or no-code tooling (Make, Zapier, Retool, Airtable).
Having already built a Claude skill, agent or automation of your own.


Benefits


Work in a genuinely AI-native team. Build with Claude, Retool and Make daily, with real budget and the freedom to automate your own job.
The ability to shape your role in a fast-growing, exciting company at the forefront of the future of e-commerce.
A workplace that's entrepreneurial, fast-paced, outcome-focused and disciplined, but also highly collaborative, team-oriented and fun.
Significant opportunity for growth and personal development, and the chance to have a real impact.
The team is fully remote, but meets in person a couple of times a month.
25 holidays + 8 bank holidays
Mental health support through Spill, and a free Headspace subscription.

Friday 04 September 2026

REG1510926

Are you interested in supporting our researchers with their open access and research data management activities? We are pleased to offer an exciting opportunity to join a team which supports our research staff and students as they plan, undertake, publish, and share their research.

You will be part of a friendly and welcoming Library Research Support Team which delivers services across the research lifecycle. We promote best practice in open research, facilitate publication and re-use of research outputs, and support discovery, access to, and management of scholarly literature and research data. You will work closely with colleagues across UoN Libraries teams and in partnership with a variety of colleagues from across Professional Services.

You will have a good understanding of the information needs of researchers and experience of working with them to promote and support open access to their publications or data. You will answer enquiries from researchers on all these topics and contribute to our inclusive training and engagement programme, supported by colleagues as you build knowledge and expertise.

We know that having colleagues from a wide range of backgrounds is key to a supportive workplace and improved services. We are particularly keen to receive applications from those who are currently underrepresented in Libraries in the UK, such as racially minoritised people.

We offer this as a permanent position, working 36.25 hours per week. Your base will be the Hallward Library on our University Park campus, but you may work across our different campuses. We have in place a hybrid working arrangement where you will be expected to spend a minimum of two days a week on campus.

We are committed to providing a competitive employment package that supports your well-being and helps you to reach your full potential. You will have access to benefits, including leading fitness and health facilities, staff discounts and travel schemes, along with a generous holiday allowance and attractive pension scheme.

Want to build technology that has a genuine impact on the safety and wellbeing of people across the UK?




We have an open Product Manager vacancy for an established, growing UK software organisation whose technology plays an important role in helping organisations protect people, communities and wider society. Their products solve complex, real-world problems, and the quality of the decisions made by the product team have a meaningful impact on the people who ultimately rely upon them.




The organisation is entering an exciting period of investment and product transformation, including the adoption of agentic AI across both its products and software development lifecycle.




You’ll take ownership of an established and successful area of the product portfolio, working closely with customers, commercial teams and software engineering to understand how the market is changing and where the biggest opportunities lie.




We’re particularly interested in experience across:

Product strategy and roadmap ownership.
Customer and market discovery.
B2B SaaS or commercial software products.
Translating complex problems into clear product requirements.
Using evidence to prioritise what should – and shouldn’t – be built.
Working closely with software engineering and agile delivery teams.
Understanding how product decisions influence revenue, retention and growth.
Presenting and defending recommendations to senior stakeholders.
Exposure to agentic AI.




The role offers a competitive salary with a flexible hybrid working pattern.

For this reason, you must have been in UK residence for 3 continuous years prior to employment and provide proof of address for the previous 5 years. Express Recruitment are representing a rapidly growing automation and controls specialist who are one of the fastest growing firms for in the ‘industry 4.0’ sector across the UK. Having already increased their headcount by over 25% in the last two years, they are continuing that trend by looking to hire another Software Engineer (with proven Python Django experience) on a full time, permanent basis.




The successful candidate will be part of a highly skilled team of Software Engineers and play a pivotal part in the technical design and delivery of high-quality software solutions for some of the best-known blue-chip firms in the UK. The best part, you will gain hands on experience with a plethora of modern technology frameworks and emerging AI technologies which will rapidly become part of your daily practice.

Experience in the design, development and testing of API interfaces
PostgreSQL database knowledge; including integration, and deployment
Proven hands-on experience with Python (Django)
.NET/C# development experience for backend services and system integrations
Blazor (Server) for interactive front-end development within the .NET ecosystem
Docker containerisation – building, deploying, and managing containerised applications and services
Knowledge of RabbitMQ, Including understanding queues, exchanges, bindings, and message routing
Confident in being able to clearly communicate and simplify technical works carried out to senior management and customers when required
Proven ability to effectively plan and prioritise yours and other workloads, ensuring project deadlines are met
Exposure gained in working with AI tools such as Copilot and Claude
Experienced working within the intralogistics, automation or material handling sector highly desirable
Full clean UK driving licence




Roles & Responsibilities




Assist in driving the development of an automated warehouse application and new features/products associated with the platform
Contribute to the innovation of the automated warehouse software department with respect to research and development, new products, and new features
Develop technical documents in line with client requirements to the industry standards, using
Adapt to the implementation and standardisation of AI development tools across the team
Attend code reviews with Lead Developers to ensure quality standards and specification requirements are me

Accompany Senior Developers on customer sites to support end-to-end commissioning and software integration works

Title: Transport Planner
Description:
Are you an experienced Transport Planner looking to take the next step in your career? Would you like to join a growing team where you'll have the opportunity to work on a variety of development planning projects and continue developing your skills within a supportive and collaborative environment? If so, we'd love to hear from you.




We're currently looking for a Transport Planner to join our Transport Planning team in Nottingham. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys delivering high-quality transport planning solutions, working collaboratively on a range of projects and building strong relationships with clients and stakeholders.




You'll be responsible for producing a range of technical reports, including Transport Notes, Transport Statements, Transport Assessments, Travel Plans, Environmental Statement Transport Chapters and Active Travel Audits, together with the associated calculations. You'll also undertake preliminary highway design using AutoCAD and use industry-standard software including TRL Junctions, LinSig/Junctions, TRICS and TEMPro.




As part of the role, you'll support the delivery and management of projects, assisting with staff resourcing, project deliverables, project financials and liaising with clients and key stakeholders. You'll also play an important role in the continued growth of the Nottingham Transport Planning team while working alongside colleagues across the wider business.




We'd love to hear from you if you have:

At least 5 years' experience working in private consultancy development planning across multiple sectors, ideally including residential, commercial and industrial developments.
A degree in Transport Planning or a related discipline.
Experience producing Transport Notes, Transport Statements, Transport Assessments, Travel Plans, Environmental Statement Transport Chapters and Active Travel Audits, together with the associated calculations.
Experience using junction capacity modelling software, including TRL Junctions and LinSig/Junctions.
Proficiency in key industry software such as TRICS, TEMPro and AutoCAD.
A good understanding of preliminary highway design and the application of relevant design standards.
Experience supporting the delivery and management of projects, including project deliverables, project financials and liaising with clients and key stakeholders.
Excellent organisational, communication, analytical and presentation skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet project deadlines.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to communicate technical information clearly to clients, colleagues and stakeholders.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office 365, particularly MS Word and MS Excel.
A proactive and collaborative approach, with the ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.
A desire to continue developing your technical knowledge and contribute to innovative transport planning solutions.
An ambition to support the continued growth of the Nottingham Transport Planning team.




Joining our team will give you:

Competitive salary and benefits package with annual salary reviews
26 days holiday per year, rising to 31 days with loyalty days, plus bank holidays
Hybrid working arrangements
Fantastic training and development culture
Access to mentoring support from industry experts
Opportunity to play a key role in exciting and varied projects
ICE Training Agreement
Opportunity to be client facing and the chance to get involved with business development and marketing activities
Fast-tracked career progression for the right candidates




About Waterman Group:

Waterman Group is a multidisciplinary consultancy providing private and public sector clients with sustainable solutions to meet the planning, engineering design and project delivery needs of the property, infrastructure, environment and energy markets.

Title: Senior Director, Data Sciences
Description:
Quotient Sciences: Molecule to Cure. Fast.

Quotient Sciences is a leading drug development and manufacturing accelerator, helping biotech and pharma companies bring new medicines to patients faster. With over 35 years of experience and a track record of success, we provide Drug Product (CDMO) and Clinical (CRO) services across the entire development pathway, including formulation development, clinical pharmacology, clinical trials, and commercial product manufacturing.

Our proprietary and disruptive platform – “Translational Pharmaceutics®” – integrates Drug Product Manufacturing and Clinical Testing to eliminate silos in the drug development process. This in turn reduces costs, improves outcomes, and significantly accelerates drug development times.

Why Join Us

Because every day counts when bringing new medicines to patients. Our 1,000+ experts across the US, UK, and beyond are united by science, agility, and a culture that turns ideas into impact—fast.

The Senior Director, Data Sciences is responsible for defining, developing, and delivering Data Sciences services for our Nottingham, Miami and partner sites. A core part of this role will be embedding AI-enabled solutions, tools and capabilities that materially improve efficiency, quality and scalability.

This role will take P&L accountability for Data Sciences and have line management responsibility for biostatistics, statistical programming, database programming, data management, pharmacokinetics and medical writing

The role will drive AI adoption by partnering with engineering, analytics and clinical/scientific stakeholders to translate business process/strategy into actionable product roadmaps, drive adoption of AI and advanced analytics, and ensure compliant responsible AI practice.

Qualifications And Experience Required For Competent Performance


A strong background in Biometrics/Data Sciences with experience in one or more function.
Proven experience leading teams, functions, or complex cross-functional delivery within Data Sciences
Experience in CRO and/or pharmaceutical environments, with understanding of clinical trial data and delivery models
Experience of operating in regulated scientific environments
Experience applying AI, advanced analytics, or automation within Biometrics environments, OR a strong understanding of how these can be embedded into clinical and biometrics workflows
Familiarity with responsible AI practices, data governance, and compliance frameworks.
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and technical mentoring skills.
Experience with GxP, validation or regulated software environments.


Main Tasks And Responsibilities


Provide leadership and guidance across Data Sciences (Biometrics) functions
Support development of the target operating model for Data Sciences
Ensure alignment across: Biostatistics, Statistical Programming, Database Programming, Data Management, PK/Pharmacometrics and Medical Writing
Contribute to talent development, capability building, and succession planning
Act as a senior link between strategy and operational delivery
Assess current state of Data Sciences and capability gaps.
Define and deliver the AI-enabled transformation roadmap for Data Sciences, aligning with organisational and scientific goals and market needs.
Effectively prioritise AI product development use cases based on business value, impact, effort and risk across statistics, PK, data management, medical writing and programming.
Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of AI products within Data Sciences, from ideation and requirements gathering to development, launch, and ongoing optimisation.
Partner with engineering, analytics, and Data Science teams to translate business strategy into actionable product features and solutions.
Help build AI literacy and confidence across Data Sciences
Ensure data governance, model compliance, and ethical use of AI are embedded into product development and deployment.
Monitor product performance, user adoption, and the realisation of business impact, using data-driven insights to inform product decisions and roadmap.
Communicate complex technical concepts and product value to stakeholders in clear, actionable terms.
Mentor and coach team members, fostering a collaborative, high-performance culture.
Stay updated with the latest advancements in Data Sciences, AI, data analytics, and product management, conducting research to explore new methodologies and applications to maximise forward-looking, value-led innovation.


Application Requirements

When applying for a position with Quotient Sciences to be able to work in our organization you must be aged 18 years or over and not have been debarred by the FDA. If you indicate you are under the age of 18 or have been debarred then your application will be automatically declined.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

Quotient Sciences are advocates for positive change and conscious inclusion. We strive to create a diverse Quotient workforce and develop a workplace culture that provides a sense of acceptance for every person within our organization. As a global employer, we recognize the value in having an organization that is a true reflection and representation of our society today.

Specifically we will not discriminate on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, gender, gender identity, pregnancy, marital status, partnership status, domestic violence victim status, sexual orientation, age, national origin, alienage or citizenship status, veteran or military status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, caregiver status, unemployment status or any other characteristic prohibited by federal, state and/or local laws.

This applies to all aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, demotion, compensation, training, working conditions, transfer, job assignments, benefits, layoff, and termination.

Our Approach to AI in Recruitment

At Quotient Sciences, we use technology, including AI-enabled tools, to support parts of our recruitment process and help create an efficient, consistent, and inclusive candidate experience. Any use of AI is subject to human oversight, and hiring decisions are made by people, not technology.

While we embrace innovation, our recruitment process remains deeply human. Candidates who progress through our recruitment process are supported by a dedicated recruitment contact, and many of our selection processes include in-person interviews. We believe the best hiring decisions come from real conversations, giving candidates the opportunity to meet future colleagues, experience our culture and showcase their strengths beyond their application.

We recognize that candidates may choose to use AI tools when preparing applications. We encourage the responsible use of technology to support research, preparation, and drafting. However, applications should reflect your own skills, experiences, and perspectives. Throughout the recruitment process, we assess authenticity, critical thinking, technical capability, and the unique contribution you can bring to Quotient Sciences. Content generated entirely by AI may not provide an accurate representation of your suitability for the role.

Title: Software Engineer II
Description:
At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.

Cadence is a pivotal leader in electronic design, building upon more than 30 years of computational software expertise. The company applies its underlying Intelligent System Design strategy to deliver software, hardware and IP that turn design concepts into reality.

Cadence customers are the world’s most innovative companies, delivering extraordinary electronic products from chips to boards to systems for the most dynamic market applications including consumer, hyperscale computing, 5G communications, automotive, aerospace industrial and health.

At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.

Job Title: Software Engineer II

Location: Nottingham, United Kingdom

Reports to: Sr Software Engineering Manager

Job Overview

Are you looking to build world-class engineering software used by leading automotive, aerospace, motorsport, electric vehicle, and renewable energy companies?

We are looking for a Software Engineer II to join our Nottingham-based product development team, contributing to the design and delivery of next-generation software applications and engineering workflows.

In this role, you will develop and enhance software applications that enable engineers to design, simulate, and analyse complex electro-mechanical systems. Working as part of a collaborative, agile team, you will implement new functionality, improve existing workflows, and contribute to the quality and long-term maintainability of our products.

Job Responsibilities


Develop and maintain software applications using C#, .NET, and WPF.
Implement new features and enhancements from requirements through design, coding, testing, and release.
Build and maintain user interfaces using XAML, data binding, and MVVM principles.
Write clean, maintainable, and testable code that meets quality and performance standards.
Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve software defects across application components.
Break down technical tasks into manageable deliverables and provide accurate progress updates.
Collaborate with software engineers, QA engineers, product managers, and domain experts to deliver high-quality solutions.
Participate actively in code reviews, design discussions, and team technical initiatives.
Develop automated tests and contribute to improving software reliability and maintainability.
Use AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude Code to improve productivity while validating generated outputs and maintaining engineering quality.


Job Qualifications


A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent professional experience. Typically, candidates will bring 2–4 years of relevant software development experience, though strong candidates earlier in their careers are encouraged to apply.
Experience developing software using C# and the .NET platform.
Strong understanding of object-oriented programming principles and design practices.
Good knowledge of asynchronous programming using async/await.
Experience developing user interfaces using WPF and XAML.
Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar technologies.
Ability to debug, test, and troubleshoot software applications.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to work effectively as part of a collaborative development team.


Skills

Additional Skills/Preferences:


Understanding of data binding and MVVM design patterns.
Familiarity with software design patterns and clean architecture principles.
Exposure to engineering, simulation, CAD, CAE, scientific, or technical software applications.
Knowledge of unit testing frameworks and automated testing practices.

Title: Head of Sales Operations
Description:
About the role




We’re looking for an experienced Head of Sales Operations to lead and optimise our sales support, performance management, pricing, reporting, and operational effectiveness across the business. This role is critical in driving profitable growth, improving sales productivity, and ensuring seamless collaboration between all stakeholders.




About Bestway




Bestway Group is a diversified multinational family-owned business with annualised turnover in excess of £4.5 billion. Starting off as a chain of retail convenience stores, the Group has grown to become a diversified multinational business with interests across the wholesale, pharmacy, real estate, cement and banking sectors. The Group is also the largest overseas investor in Pakistan.

Owned by the Pervez, Choudrey and Sheikh families, Bestway Group was founded in 1976 by Sir Anwar Pervez OBE H Pk, who remains Chairman. Serving over 12 million customers and employing over 28,000 individuals, the Group supports and serves communities through its operations across the UK, Pakistan and the Middle East.




Responsibilities:




Develop and lead the Sales Operations function, ensuring effective support for field sales, telesales, national accounts, and business development teams.
Take responsibility for the existing telesales operation and ensure it operates efficiently and deliver operational improvements
Develop and implement operational strategies that improve sales efficiency, customer retention, and revenue growth.
Establish clear sales processes, KPIs, and performance frameworks across all sales channels.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational performance and customer experience.
Support sales reporting, forecasting, budgeting, and pipeline analysis.
Deliver actionable insights on sales performance, profitability, customer trends, and product mix.
Produce regular commercial dashboards and executive reports for senior leadership.
Monitor pricing, rebates, promotions, and margin performance to support commercial decision-making.
Partner with sales leadership to support territory planning, target setting, incentive schemes, and resource allocation.
Develop sales tools, reporting frameworks, and operational processes that improve sales execution.
Support onboarding, training, and development of sales teams in operational best practices.
Lead the optimisation and governance of CRM and sales systems.
Ensure data accuracy, reporting integrity, and effective sales analytics capabilities.
Identify opportunities for automation and process improvement through technology and digital tools.




The Ideal Candidate:




Comprehensive understanding and experience of the foodservice wholesale
Experienced sales individual / sales operations leader
Commercially driven and results orientated
Experience of leading and developing the business use of a CRM
Ability to work with data and drive data-led decision making
Continuous improvement mindset
Puts the customer first across all activity




Benefits:




Competitive salary
Pension
22 days annual leave plus the option to buy additional days
Life Assurance
Private Medical

Title: Data Migration Lead - HR Transformation
Description:
Role: Data Migration Lead – HR Transformation

Contract: Fixed-Term – 18 Months

Location: Nottingham, Beeston

Recruitment Partner: Kershia Broughton

What You'll Be Doing

As the Data Migration Lead for HR Transformation, you will play a pivotal role in overseeing a large-scale enterprise data migration programme within our HR department.

This role is responsible for defining and governing the end-to-end approach for extracting, cleansing, transforming, validating, reconciling, archiving and migrating data from HR platforms into new systems. The Data Migration Lead will act as the primary authority for data migration and archival activities, partnering closely with HR (including data analysts/SMEs from that function), IT, incumbent platform suppliers and the HR Systems Integrator to ensure the successful transition of data to the new platform.

As the accountable Data Migration Lead, they will be involved throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring that migration solutions are fit for purpose, compliant with data privacy requirements and aligned to programme objectives. The role will work closely with the Project Manager, Solution Architect, Enterprise Architecture and the Systems Integrator Data Migration Lead to resolve migration challenges and ensure delivery success.

Key Responsibilities


Define migration principles, standards, quality gates and governance controls and owning the overall data migration, data archiving and data retention strategy.
Define migration waves, cutover approaches and archival requirements and identify key migration risks, assumptions and dependencies.
Oversee ETL activities and lead mock migrations, dress rehearsals and production migration events.
Review migration deliverables and ensure integrity of migrated data.
Ensure compliance with GDPR, security and governance policies, defining controls for handling personal and sensitive data.
Establish audit and reconciliation processes.
Act as primary counterpart to the Systems Integrator Data Migration Lead.
Manage relationships with incumbent HR platform suppliers to facilitate data extracts and archival activities and challenge migration solutions where appropriate.
Facilitate workshops and migration decision forums.
Communicate complex data concepts in business-friendly language.


What You'll Need To Have (our Must-haves)


Experience leading at least two large-scale enterprise data migration programmes involving multiple source systems, complex data landscapes and significant business transformation.
Experience working in complex environments involving multiple suppliers, implementation partners and legacy platforms.
Strong understanding of how data migration activities integrate with testing, cutover, business readiness and operational transition.
Experience defining migration governance, controls, quality gates and success criteria.
Ability to manage technical, business and regulatory requirements to deliver successful migration outcomes.
Deep knowledge of data migration methodologies and best practices across the full migration lifecycle.
Strong technical understanding of data discovery, profiling, ETL/ELT, quality management, remediation, reconciliation and validation.
Experience with data governance, data privacy, GDPR and information security controls.
Experience with data archiving, retention and legacy system decommissioning.
Strong understanding of data migration tools, accelerators and automation processes.
Ability to challenge and influence suppliers and delivery partners to ensure migration solutions are robust, efficient and aligned to programme objectives.


It Would Be Great If You Also Have


Experience with global HR deployments across multiple geographies.
Background in HR process optimisation or HR technology strategy.


Where Your Brilliance Can Take You

At Boots, your role as Data Migration Lead opens up numerous pathways for career advancement. You will have the opportunity to develop your skills in data governance and transformation, positioning yourself for future leadership roles within the Technology team. With a commitment to professional growth and a supportive culture, you can shape your career while making a significant impact on the organisation.

Discretionary annual bonus
Generous employee discounts

Flexible benefits scheme including option to buy additional holiday, discounted gym membership, life assurance, activity passes and much more.

Finance (FP&A) Analyst

Job Title: Finance (FP&A) Analyst

Location: Nottingham - Hybrid

Working Pattern: 3 days in-office (Tuesday-Thursday) and 2 days remote.

Our Mission

We’re on a mission to be a force for good in lending. Throughout our almost 30-year history, we’ve consistently been recognised as a great place to work; in 2026, Capital One was officially ranked 9th in the UK’s Best Workplaces™ list. Hear from our team about what it’s like working at Capital One UK.

About The Role

We are looking for a FP&A analyst to help drive our best-in-class FP&A team. As a team we are responsible for a myriad of critical items, including executive reporting, senior stakeholder engagement, insight-focused analysis of our portfolio, and team enablement (i.e. raising departmental technical aptitude). The role adds value to Finance’s business partnering capability by providing accurate and important information at the right time.

With the support of your manager, you will be responsible for the production of our suite of executive financial reporting and will be working with other Business Partners within the finance team to deliver the key messages for the business. The role also involves partnership with stakeholder teams within the US.

What you’ll do


Synthesising and simplifying financial and non-financial data
Supporting in production of Month End reports; Working with team members and the wider FP&A team to feed into monthly financials review (MFR) meetings and/or other reporting requirements
Supporting delivery of Quarterly Financial reviews and other monthly/quarterly tasks at high quality and within deadlines
Supporting ad hoc reporting requests from leadership
Developing reporting to facilitate monitoring and communication of performance against targets or to support review of outlooks (i.e. forecasts) and budgets
Ensuring reporting reflects the most up-to-date and accurate information available.
Supporting in depth analysis into our portfolio to drive key financial insights


How you’ll be doing it


Utilising all systems and applications relevant to the required outputs of the role (e.g., OneStream, Workday, G-Suite, Microsoft Office).
Investigating new technologies and tools and supporting process improvement workstreams
Using business knowledge to enable work to be focussed on finance priorities
Pushing the envelope of our capabilities via new data and automation
Focusing on key risks and opportunities
Collaborating across finance teams to deliver business outcomes together


What we’re looking for


Functional knowledge of accounting and financial principles (e.g. P&L, budget & forecast etc)
Strong attention to detail and proactive approach to delivering results
Strong analytical skills e.g. outlook variance, overall story, accuracy, spotting errors and asking the right questions
Communication - within and outside Finance. Ability to tailor written and verbal comms as appropriate
Relationship building and stakeholder management with teams internal and external to Finance
Continuous improvement and change-agility mindset
Technical skills/willingness to learn (e.g. familiarity with python, sql, snowflake, AI tools etc) a major plus!


Where and how you'll work

This is a permanent position based in our [Nottingham / London] office.

We embrace a hybrid approach to work. You'll spend three days a week in the office (Tuesday-Thursday), with Monday and Friday being dedicated work-from-home days.

Our offices are designed to inspire and support you. At our Nottingham head office, you'll find an on-site gym, restaurant and dedicated Learning Loft.

What’s in it for you

We invest in the growth of our people alongside our business. You will have extensive opportunities to learn and develop your career, including access to up to £5,000 in funding for external qualifications.

Benefits

In addition to career development, our comprehensive benefits package is designed to grow with you, ensuring your wellbeing is prioritised at every stage of your career:


Wealth & Future: Competitive pension and performance-based bonus schemes
Holidays: Start with 25 days of annual leave, increasing with tenure. Need more? You have the option to buy 5 additional days.
Health: Access premium care through our private medical insurance.
Family Support: We champion your milestones with enhanced parental leave.


A full list of our benefits is available here.

What You Should Know About How We Recruit

We pride ourselves on hiring the best people, not the same people. Building diverse and inclusive teams is the right thing to do and the smart thing to do. We want to work with top talent: whoever you are, whatever you look like, wherever you come from. We know it’s about what you do, not just what you say. That’s why we make our recruitment process fair and accessible.

We value diversity, inclusion and belonging at our core. We empower our associates to do great work by creating an inclusive culture—one that values diverse perspectives, fosters collaboration and encourages innovative ideas—and a place where associates of all backgrounds can thrive by bringing their most authentic selves to work. We call this our Culture of Belonging, and it rests at the heart of our business.

Our associate-led Business Resource Groups were created to help support our diverse population and include over 10 groups across our offices. Because each Business Resource Group is as unique as the population it serves, they offer a range of activities, networking opportunities, special events and learning programmes to associates.

Capital One is committed to diversity in the workplace.

If you require a reasonable adjustment, please contact ukrecruitment@capitalone.com All information will be kept confidential and will only be used for the purpose of applying a reasonable adjustment.

For technical support or questions about Capital One's recruiting process, please send an email to Careers@capitalone.com

Capital One does not provide, endorse nor guarantee and is not liable for third-party products, services, educational tools or other information available through this site.

Capital One Financial is made up of several different entities. Please note that any position posted in Canada is for Capital One Canada, any position posted in the United Kingdom is for Capital One Europe and any position posted in the Philippines is for Capital One Philippines Service Corp. (COPSSC).

Who We Are

At Capital One, we're building a leading information-based technology company. Still founder-led by Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Richard Fairbank, Capital One is on a mission to help our customers succeed by bringing ingenuity, simplicity, and humanity to banking. We measure our efforts by the success our customers enjoy and the advocacy they exhibit. We are succeeding because they are succeeding.

Guided by our shared values, we thrive in an environment where collaboration and openness are valued. We believe that innovation is powered by perspective and that teamwork and respect for each other lead to superior results. We elevate each other and obsess about doing the right thing. Our associates serve with humility and a deep respect for their responsibility in helping our customers achieve their goals and realize their dreams. Together, we are on a quest to change banking for good.

Title: Statistical Programmer 2 - UK/Serbia - Remote
Description:
Who We Are

We’re a global, midsize CRO that pushes boundaries, innovates and invents because the path to a cure for the world’s most persistent diseases is not paved by those who play it safe. It is built by those who take pioneering, creative approaches and implement them with quality and excellence.

We are Worldwide Clinical Trials, and we are a global team of over 3,500+ experts, bright thinkers, dreamers and doers and, together, we are changing the way the world experiences CROs – in the best possible way.

Our mission is to work with passion and purpose every day to improve lives and we are looking for others who value this same pursuit.

Why Worldwide

We believe everyone plays an important role in making a world of difference for patients and their caregivers. From our hands-on, accessible leaders, to our cohesive and supportive teams, we are committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed. We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us!

What Global Programming Does At Worldwide

The Worldwide team is an experienced and diverse group of Programmers who collaborate together as one, both via regularly scheduled group meetings to discuss issues, and impromptu one-on-one discussions between colleagues to discuss a particular topic.

As a Statistical Programmer on a project – you will be working with statisticians, sponsors, the wider study team and your own team of programmers, ensuring the data and output delivered for a study meets industry, regulatory submission and quality standards. As a Statistical Programmer at Worldwide, your analytical skills and ability to both program and understand / interpret data are the keys to success, and you will have the opportunity to continually grow your knowledge in SAS and CDISC across all phases and multiple therapy areas.

What You Will Do


Develop, test and execute SAS programs to produce and validate CDISC SDTM and ADaM datasets, tables, figures and listings (TFL).
Perform review of the clinical database specification, data transfer agreement/specification, programming related parts of Statistical Analysis plan including TFL shells for medium complexity studies.
Develop and review specification for SDTM datasets and ADaM datasets for safety data, TFL shells and other specifications, e.g. patient profiles, OPS reports.
Develop electronic data submission package (SDTM annotated CRF, define.xml, Study/Analysis Data Reviewer's Guide) for medium complexity studies.
Serve as a programming project lead on medium complexity studies (e.g. multy-part phase I study, parallel group phase II/III study with multiple endpoints) to distribute and oversee tasks for the programming team, communicate with internal and external clients, plan and execute delivery, and manage resources and competing project priorities with line manager or mentor support. Ensure budget and scope of project work remain aligned.


What You Will Bring To The Role


Must be computer literate and numerate with a willingness to adapt to various computer systems.
Hands-on expert level project statistical programmer experienced in providing programming leadership to projects.
Statistical programming skills and knowledge across a broad range of applications together with key competencies in customer focus, delivering on commitments, building strong relationships, communicating and influencing, and embracing innovation and change.


Your Experience


Educated to degree level or equivalent.
Advanced SAS programming skills with knowledge in SAS/Macro, Proc Report and ODS. Good working knowledge in SAS/Graph, Proc SQL.
Minimum 3 years of previous related experience.


We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.

To view our other roles, check out our careers page at Discover a world of difference at Worldwide! For more information on Worldwide, visit www.Worldwide.com or connect with us on LinkedIn.

Worldwide is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed and, to that end, we prioritize attracting diverse talent and cultivating an inclusive environment that encourages collaboration and creativity. We know that when our employees feel appreciated and included, they can be more creative, innovative, and successful. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to creating exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. Title: Senior Solutions Analyst - Decisioning
Description:
Company Description

Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We help to redefine lending practices, uncover and prevent fraud, simplify healthcare, create marketing solutions, and gain deeper insights into the automotive market, all using our unique combination of data, analytics and software. We also assist millions of people to realize their financial goals and help them save time and money.

We invest in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. As a FTSE 100 Index company listed on the London Stock Exchange (EXPN), we have a team of 22,500 people across 32 countries. Our corporate headquarters are in Dublin, Ireland. Learn more at experianplc.com.

Internal Grade E/EB9

Job Description

Experian's Consumer Information Services, Analytics, Decisioning Software, and Identity and Fraud division are looking for a Senior Solutions Analyst. You will be responsible for the effective engineering of capability within the Decisioning Solutions content reuse, off-the-shelf, and prefabricated solution (PCCA) space, working closely with other engineering team members in the team, and across wider build and development functions.

Senior Solutions Analysts are pivotal in the design, maintenance and execution of the product backlog and concurrently driving complexity out of client System Integration. Decisioning Engineering's goal, and the role every Senior Solutions Analyst must play is transforming time and cost to deliver.

This is a Hybrid, Nottingham based role (40% in the office) reporting to the Senior Client Delivery Manager

Key Responsibilities

Working within Decisioning Solutions (DS) Engineering you will be a senior member of one of our regional engineering teams, delivering high quality proof-of-concept, template, and accelerator content that will be used by our System Integration Teams to deliver effective integrated Client Solutions.


Responsible for driving the ease of integration across the System Integration Teams to reduce complexity, time to deliver, cost and risk whilst improving customer satisfaction. Working with the Global Engineering teams (who build the core products) and by engineering effective and efficient localised solutions.
Focus on cloud cost optimisation to ensure best practice is adopted across all cloud based client system integrations, driving down cost to serve.
Offer expert consultancy for Pre-Sales, System Integration Teams, Service Support and Risk Management.
You will lead junior members of our delivery "fireteams", steering analysts, project managers, implementers, developers and testers maximising the most appropriate delivery model for the work (Waterfall, Agile etc).
Lead deliveries ensuring that they meet agreed timelines (proactively managing any issue and risks that arise) and cost.
You will build great relationships while consulting with our Global Engineering (ESS), Product Management, Customer Value Office, Go-to-Market (GTM), Product Capability, Systems Integration, Security, Audit and Risk teams to drive efficient / effective processes and outcomes.
You will occasionally be responsibility for maintaining good relationships with our competitors, partners, clients to enable new capability to be engineered effectively.


Qualifications


Expert understanding of Decisioning Solution products and how they can be integrated and deployed to clients.
Experience leading development, build, technical authorship, project management and consultative/delivery teams in a financial services environment.
Understanding of PowerCurve
Project Management experience in a client facing environment.
Demonstratable knowledge of waterfall and agile methodologies and best practice and experience in a scaled agile delivery environment
Commercial acumen in accordance with contracted commitments.
Experience balancing competing projects and providing thought leadership in areas that may be new to stakeholders.
Experience leading and coaching multi-disciplinary teams, developing team members, and supporting them to grow.


Additional Information

Benefits include:-


Great compensation package and discretionary bonus plan
Core benefits include pension, bupa healthcare, sharesave scheme and more!
25 days annual leave with 8 bank holidays and 3 volunteering days. You can also purchase additional annual leave.

Experian will never ask candidates to make any payment as part of an application, interview, assessment, onboarding, or recruitment process. To apply for roles or verify opportunities, please visit experian.com/careers.

Everyone can succeed at Experian and bring their whole self to work, irrespective of their gender, ethnicity, religion, colour, sexuality, physical ability or age. Title: Condition Monitoring Engineer
Description:
The Role

Due to growth of our Monitoring Team, we are now seeking a Mechanical Engineer to support our customers in the EU market. As part of a global team of wind turbine health monitoring engineers and analysts, you will lead regional projects focused on connecting machinery to the cloud and delivering high-quality wind turbine health monitoring services to our clients.

What You’ll Do


Provide an excellent wind turbine condition health monitoring service to customers in our EU region
Monitor asset performance using our fleetMONITOR software and report on alarms and asset health
Support the new customer onboarding process, contributing to the effective mobilisation of services to new customers
Identify opportunities to provide added-value services to customers around performance such as consulting and training
Ensure that the health monitoring service provided to our customers is of the highest possible quality standard.
Work with ONYX colleagues around the world to identify and develop service improvement opportunities.


What You’ll Have


Undergraduate degree in relevant STEM subject (e.g. Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Aeronautical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Mathematics, or Physics).
Understanding of dynamics of rotating machinery engineering and vibration analysis.
Python or Matlab programming experience; networking/connectivity knowledge, including large/automated data transfer, VPN technologies, and databases
Good knowledge of data processing technique, signal processing, feature extraction
Good to have: good knowledge of data mining or machine learning testing, regression analysis
Ideal - UK IMechE qualified or working towards; Mobius Institute- accredited; Spanish and/or Portuguese language skills; PhD and or Masters degree.


About ONYX

ONYX Insight is a growing technology and engineering organisation in the renewable energy sector. Our vision is to build a more efficient future by becoming the world’s most innovative provider of predictive technology solutions. Our advanced sensing, software and analytics combined with our engineering experience are deployed on wind turbines around the world to maximise production and make turbines more reliable for longer, optimising energy production.

ONYX Insight is part of the Macquarie Group. Macquarie is a global financial services group operating in 34 markets in asset management, leasing and asset financing, market access, commodity trading, renewables development, specialist advisory services, capital raising and principal investment. Title: Product Performance Manager
Description:
Contract type: Permanent




Hours: Full-time, 35 hours




Location: Head Office, Nottingham (Hybrid working, minimum 2 days per week)




Salary: Up to £65,000 per annum (depending on experience)




Application process: Please apply via the application button which will direct you to our careers site. If you require any adjustments to assist you in applying, please contact careers@thenottingham.com




We’re hiring a Product Performance Managers!




In this role, you’ll oversee how our mortgage strategy comes to life commercially, owning performance management within a key lending segment and helping us achieve our ambitions.




Here’s a taste of what you will be doing as a Product Performance Manager at Nottingham Building Society: -

Own performance across your product segments, including metrics, triggers and actions to drive results.
Oversee the end-to-end product proposition (such as features, criteria and affordability) in partnership with Credit Risk, Sales, Operations and Marketing colleagues.
Monitor sales performance and pipeline conversion, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and customer outcomes.
Lead product reviews, identifying key risks and opportunities.
Bring deep market insight (competitors, customer needs, regulation) and turn this into actionable improvements.
Own our approach to fair value, fees and charges.
Shape customer communications and retention strategies.
Collaborate with Pricing to influence overall pricing strategy.




About you: -

Experience in mortgage product or similar roles within a regulated financial services environment.
Demonstrated success in driving customer and commercial outcomes through holistic product management.




Reward & Benefits -

A fair and competitive salary evaluated against market data, annual discretionary bonus scheme, Medicash healthcare scheme, 29 days annual leave plus bank holidays and enhanced family leave.
Commitment and dedication to your ongoing personal and professional development. We help you to own and grow your potential so you can be at your best in your current role and to support your future career aspirations.
For all full-time roles we work a 35-hour working week to promote a work/life balance, we want you to be at your best inside and outside of work.
A friendly and inclusive culture where teams genuinely strive to do the right thing by their colleagues and our customers.
A strong sustainability agenda – we’re continually finding new ways to be kinder to the environment by reducing our carbon footprint.
We’re passionate about giving back to the communities in which we serve as well as supporting local charities as part of the Samuel Fox Foundation. One of the many ways you can get involved is to use the 2 days per year paid leave to volunteer for causes or charities that are important to you.
Your health and wellbeing is our priority, we encourage this through a suite of support resources, including a team of trained mental health first aiders.




Embracing Diversity Together: -

We proudly embrace and celebrate diversity as a fundamental cornerstone of our values. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace is not just essential for our success but is also a reflection of the vibrant communities we serve. Our commitment to diversity extends beyond our internal culture to the way we approach advertising and engage with our customers.

Our commitment means actively working to eliminate barriers and biases that may hinder equal opportunities within our organisation. We strive to ensure that all individuals, regardless of background, have an equal chance to thrive and advance in their careers.

We acknowledge that diversity is not just a goal to be achieved but a continuous journey toward creating an environment that embraces differences and promotes equal opportunities for all. We are committed to fostering an inclusive culture that encourages collaboration, creativity, and a sense of belonging for every member of our community.




About us: -




Together we overcome barriers and shape brighter futures for our customers, colleagues and our communities.

We are a mutual, which means we don’t have shareholders. Instead, we’re owned by our members and use our money to do good, investing in our community, responsible causes, and – well, you. So, we’re always striving to do the right thing for our colleagues, communities and members.

Although our history spans over 170 years, our purpose of helping our members save, plan for and protect their financial futures is enduring. At Nottingham Building Society, we are dedicated to overcoming obstacles and turning challenges into opportunities. At the heart of our mission is our unwavering commitment to breaking down barriers and building better futures by helping our customers achieve the significant milestone of owning their own home.

Title: ESG Manager – Governance, Data and Systems
Description:
Location: Nottingham

Contract: 12 month fixed term / 3 days per week

Recruitment Partner: Frankie McCallister-Lyas

About The Role

Our long-standing commitment to Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) spans more than 176 years and this commitment has shaped the way we deliver trusted healthcare and wellness to communities as a cornerstone of our strategy and impact.

Our ESG Centre of Excellence team brings together many of our key ESG roles. This role is a central part of the team, focusing on the ESG data, systems, disclosures and related initiatives.

Reporting to the Head of ESG, Strategy, Governance and Data, this role is instrumental in driving business results by designing the architecture and developing the tools, systems and processes required to collect, analyse and verify ESG data ensuring continued regulatory compliance.

Key Responsibilities


Implement a scalable ESG data system architecture, enabling seamless integration and governance of internal and external data sources with corporate systems.
Address system dependencies and data quality challenges by developing clear quality assurance and validation processes for ESG metrics and disclosures.
Translate ESG data insights into actionable recommendations to influence cross-functional stakeholders, including data owners and finance business partners.
Collaborate with IT, compliance, sustainability and finance teams, and subject matter experts to maintain data integrity and ensure assurance/audit-ready ESG disclosures.
Support and drive strategic ESG data-driven projects such as Double Materiality Assessments, Climate Scenario Analysis, and Carbon foot-printing across the company.
Attend and represent the company at external meetings, conferences and seminars as needed.


What You’ll Need To Have


Strong communications skills, written and spoken.
Strong interpersonal skills – persuasion and influencing others, using a range of approaches, to achieve deliverables and build strong relationships.
Problem solving capabilities, ability to cut through complexity and provide effective solutions. Judgement to identify risks and opportunities.
Leadership skills to drive projects and provide guidance on sensitive issues.
Expertise in strategic thinking, long term planning and leveraging data insights to drive business results.
Experience developing and delivering presentations to the most senior levels within the organisation.
Team player.
Bachelor’s degree or professional certification.


It Would Be Great If You Also Have


Experience in using ESG Data platforms such as Sphera or equivalent.
Experience in and knowledge of environmental, social, governance (ESG) industry issues and integration with business operations.
Experience working with an ESG platform tool.
Experience in retail, healthcare, sustainability or in a dynamic global corporate organisation.


Rewards Designed For You


Pension membership

Discretionary annual bonus
Generous employee discounts
Flexible benefits scheme

Description:
Company Description

Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.

Job Description

We're looking for a Sales Support Administrator, with experience of working with sales team, to provide administrative sales support to one of the sales team in GTM, focusing on efficient processing and maintenance of core sales and revenue activities.

You will support internal sales teams and operational processes rather than acting as a client-facing relationship owner. You will ensure orders, billing, and system updates are completed accurately and on time, contributing to a smooth sales and revenue cycle.

Responsibilities

Operational & Administrative Support


Process and maintain Sales BU activities, including:
Resetting and updating system settings
Maintaining accurate product and customer configurations
Support revenue and billing activities ensuring accuracy of data and alignment with agreed commercial terms
Process new orders and quick-win opportunities, ensuring timely setup and readiness for delivery
Complete routine data entry and updates across systems (e.g. CRM / billing / systems)

Sales Support (Execution)


Support the preparation and processing of quotes, orders and contracts, ensuring information is complete and accurate
Maintain clean and up-to-date CRM records for all supported transactions
Track progress of orders and raise issues where information is missing or incorrect


Process & Quality


Follow defined processes and procedures to ensure consistency and compliance
Identify and escalate data quality issues or recurring errors to senior team members
Support simple process improvements through feedback on operational challenges


Communication & Coordination


Act as a point of contact for internal queries relating to order processing, billing or setup
Liaise with relevant internal teams (e.g. billing, ops, support) to resolve queries and complete tasks
Provide timely updates on task progress and completion


Qualifications


Experience in a sales administrative, sales support, or sales operations role
Experience speaking to customers.
Comfortable working with systems such as CRM, billing platforms or internal tools
Strong attention to detail with the ability to handle high-volume, process-driven work
Good written and verbal communication skills
Ability to follow processes and work within defined guidelines


Additional Information

Benefits package includes:


Hybrid working - 40% office based
Great compensation package and discretionary bonus
Core benefits include Pension, Bupa healthcare, Sharesave Scheme and more
25 days annual leave with 8 bank holidays and 3 volunteering days. You can purchase additional annual leave.

Strong commercial acumen and the ability to analyse financial information clearly.

A collaborative spirit, thriving in a fast-paced environment while also being able to work autonomously.

In this role, you'll deliver high-performing, multi-channel marketing campaigns that inspire future students to 'Change what's next' at the University of Nottingham.

As a Marketing Executive, you'll support the planning, delivery, optimisation, and evaluation of integrated marketing campaigns that build awareness, generate leads, and drive student recruitment across UK and international audiences. Working collaboratively, you'll deliver campaign activity across a wide range of channels, including website, digital advertising, email marketing, social media, content marketing and SEO. Using data and insight to inform your decision, you'll help create engaging customer journeys and deliver campaigns that achieve standout results.

This is an exciting opportunity in a fast-paced and creative environment, which has all the benefits of hybrid-working (a mixture of working from home and on our beautiful Jubilee Campus). Our university changes lives, so if you’re a highly motivated and disciplined marketer who thrives on meeting customer needs and delivering high-impact results, this is the opportunity you’ve been looking for.

We offer:


A friendly, diverse, and supportive working environment
A hybrid working arrangement with a blend of home and office working each week
Generous holiday entitlement of 27 days (or pro rata) plus standard bank holidays and five university closure days including closure between Christmas and New Year.
Access to training, continued support, and career development opportunities
A range of benefits and rewards, including fitness and health facilities, staff discounts, travel schemes and much more (see our benefits website for details)
